name: Amortization (the pre-paid shutter)
what: Difficulty is conserved but time-shifted: an 'easy' read is cheap NOW only because the compute/time was spent THEN, stored as the negentropy of the observer's prior; the instant-crush cashes stored credit.
framework_tie: Headline creature of DIGESTION_DYNAMICS sec 12; the COST-law beside the render-laws of THE_LATENT_CAMERA. Splits measured_bits into PRESENT effort (shutter) + AMORTIZED past effort (film ISO). Resolves observer-relativity as 'whose debt is settled'.
formal_name: Amortized inference (ML) / amortized analysis (algorithms) / prequential MDL & Excess Description Length / logical depth (its physical face)
field: machine learning + algorithm analysis + information theory
citation: Tarjan 'Amortized Computational Complexity' (1985); CLRS ch.17; 'Neural Methods for Amortized Inference' arXiv:2404.12484; Blier-Ollivier 2018; EDL arXiv:2601.04728; Bennett 'Logical Depth and Physical Complexity' (1988)
observable: Measure BOTH clocks and report their ratio. PRESENT = verified resistance-curve rho(effort) against a pinned observer; AMORTIZED = prequential/EDL learning-debt (cold vs warm codelength) OR cross-epoch decoder gap D(1789) vs D(2026) OR logical-depth proxy (run-time of shortest regenerating program). Signature of an amortized item: LOW present rho but HIGH amortized credit.

name: Maintenance (energy to HOLD against decay)
what: Holding a fact/skill/representation steady against drift costs continuous energy (refresh, rehearsal, error-correction). Stop paying and it slides.
framework_tie: The 'against a clock' edge as a HOLDING cost, not a solving cost; the running cost of keeping a dissolved stone dissolved. Thermo-welds to sec 12 e-units: held bits cost Joules to refresh (storage face of Landauer). Cost-dual of the forgetting creature.
formal_name: Stability-plasticity dilemma / rehearsal & regularization cost; thermodynamic cost of reliable memory & error-correction; working-memory maintenance cost — NOT a clean single name
field: continual learning + thermodynamics of computation + cognitive science
citation: van de Ven et al. arXiv:2403.05175; PRX Quantum 3.020318 (2022); Landauer reliability bound Int. J. Theor. Phys. (Springer A:1026422630734)
observable: REFRESH RATE to keep residue flat: dissolve W to r0, re-measure rho(W) at t1,t2,... WITHOUT re-presenting evidence, log energy/ops injected to keep r(t)<=r0+eps. Readouts: (a) hold-cost = refresh-bits/time; (b) stability-plasticity frontier = BWT penalty per unit new learning admitted. Tell: residue creeps up monotonically when refresh withheld.

name: Rot / Forgetting (the debt un-pays itself)
what: Pre-paid credit is not permanent: a dissolved target re-solidifies as the prior drifts, the world moves, or new learning overwrites it. The shutter that opened freely starts to stick.
framework_tie: Time-reverse of amortization: paid debt LEAKING BACK, residue drifting back up; the developed image fades. Diachronic decoder D(t) run backward — same fact sharp at t0, fuzzy at t1 because the prior decayed, not because evidence changed.
formal_name: Catastrophic forgetting / model staleness & temporal degradation / knowledge collapse / software bit-rot
field: machine learning / software engineering
citation: McCloskey & Cohen 1989; van de Ven arXiv:2403.05175; 'Are LLMs Prescient?' arXiv:2411.08324; knowledge collapse arXiv:2509.04796; Shumailov et al. Nature 2024
observable: DRIFT of residue on a held-fixed target. (a) Backward Transfer (BWT) = residue on old targets before vs after new learning (negative BWT = forgetting, in bits); (b) temporal-validity half-life = time for >50% of freshly-dissolved residue to re-solidify with NO intervention. Dangerous signature = COLLAPSE elbow: residue stays low (fluent) while forward-prediction (Law 1) starts failing ('confidently wrong').

name: Debt / Shortcut (cheap-now, brittle-later) [absorbs critic's 'Path' option-value/irreversibility]
what: Take the quick map: pay little NOW but a compounding penalty accrues against the FUTURE — every later op over the shortcut costs more (interest) until refactor or break. Extended here to cover irreversibility/lock-in and the option value of staging vs committing.
framework_tie: Sign-flip of amortization on the SAME time-shift axis: cost moved to the FUTURE that compounds. COST-cousin of the camera's fake-dissolve: renders sharp now (low apparent bits) without cashing the verified-dissolve gate, so unpaid bits resurface. MERGE NOTE: critic's 'The Path' (irreversibility/hysteresis/real-options/lock-in) is folded here — sunk-cost escalation and ratchet effects are the same future-debt axis made directional; the only genuinely new sub-bit is option value, captured in the observable.
formal_name: Technical debt (principal+interest) / shortcut learning / sunk-cost & escalation of commitment; + real-options value & irreversibility / lock-in / path dependence (Dixit-Pindyck, Arthur)
field: software engineering + behavioral economics + ML + economics (real options)
citation: Cunningham 1992; Geirhos et al. Nature Machine Intelligence 2020 (shortcut learning); Arkes & Blumer 1985; Staw 1976; Dixit & Pindyck 1994 'Investment Under Uncertainty'; Arthur 1989 (lock-in)
observable: Gap between apparent and verified present cost plus forward interest: (a) principal = bits skipped = verified-dissolve residue MINUS shortcut's claimed residue; (b) interest = slope of future rho on dependents inheriting the shortcut; (c) brittleness = residue spike under distribution shift off the spurious cue. Path/option-value adds: trajectory-order sensitivity (permute identical move-set, measure outcome variance), and reversal-cost as a function of how many later moves built on a commitment. Sunk-cost confound: effort that rises with PRIOR investment rather than remaining residue.

name: Effort-decay / temporal-discounting of the digestion drive
what: WILLINGNESS to keep chewing decays as the clock runs: late in a budget the same residue draws less effort. The prize is discounted against elapsed time, so dissolution stalls before the true capacity floor — an apparent stone that is really an abandoned dig.
framework_tie: Unnamed in the seeds: amortization/debt/maintenance treat energy as available-on-demand; this says the DRIVE itself is time-dependent. Separates CAN'T (true epistemic floor) from WON'T (effort gave out) — critical for Latent Olympics fairness (a tokens-to-dissolve leaderboard is biased by athletes that quit early).
formal_name: [novel - no clean prior]; nearest: hyperbolic temporal discounting + early-stopping/budget exhaustion + 'underthinking' (premature termination)
field: cog-sci / behavioral economics + ML reasoning
citation: Laibson QJE 1997; underthinking contrast arXiv:2412.21187; budget-forcing s1 arXiv:2501.19393
observable: Disentangle WON'T from CAN'T by perturbing drive at fixed capability: re-run the same target with (i) raised budget B'>B, (ii) mid-run reward bump, (iii) pause-and-resume. If residue drops on ANY without new capability, the asymptote was effort-decay (WON'T) not the floor (CAN'T). Report two asymptotes: r_drive (where this mind stopped) and r_floor (where it stops even re-motivated).

name: Provenance amnesia / orphaned-credit hazard
what: An amortized cheap-read forgets WHICH past payment bought it. The credit still cashes but the derivation chain is detached, so when the underlying derivation is falsified or rots, every downstream item riding that credit is brittle without warning.
framework_tie: Collision of amortization (sec 12) with camera Law 1 (fidelity-not-truth) and the independence requirement. If the store keeps no audit trail you can't tell a verified-dissolve credit from an unpaid shortcut (debt) — they look identically cheap. Cost-side of 'ten papers copying one wire'; the un-tracked dead-child.
formal_name: [novel - no clean prior]; nearest: data/feature provenance & lineage; latent confounding via shared sources; cache invalidation; staleness propagation
field: info theory / data provenance + ML
citation: Buneman et al. 2001 (data provenance); independence-discount of THE_LATENT_CAMERA Law 1; staleness propagation (Tacnode 2026)
observable: Audit LINEAGE behind every cheap read: (a) provenance depth = does the credit trace to a verified-dissolve or to a single/unpaid source (audit-trail length + independence count); (b) orphan rate = fraction of cheap reads whose earning-derivation can't be reconstructed on demand; (c) blast radius = number of downstream low-residue items that re-solidify when one upstream derivation is knocked out. Tell: low rho AND provenance depth ~0 / independence count = 1.

name: Problem-as-gatekeeper
what: The problem is itself a wrapper: a canon+facts membrane guarding an irreducible solution-kernel; only the kernel survives all valid preprocessing/pressure.
framework_tie: The opponent wrapper, source of the static residue measured_bits = min(cost_ub, evidence_lcb): the kernel is exactly what does NOT melt into the prior. Camera Law 2 (sharpness<1). aleatoric_floor = model-independent stone; epistemic shell = gatekept-but-crackable.
formal_name: Kernelization / problem kernel + kernel-size lower bounds; intrinsic hardness / complexity lower bounds; aleatoric vs epistemic uncertainty split
field: parameterized complexity theory / computational complexity (+ ML uncertainty quantification)
citation: Bodlaender, Downey, Fellows & Hermelin (kernel lower bounds); Dom, Lokshtanov & Saurabh (Colors and IDs); aleatoric/epistemic line DIGESTION_DYNAMICS sec 11.2 (ICLR-2025 irreducible-loss; effective-complexity arXiv:0810.5663)
observable: rho(effort) asymptote: rising effort budgets, record bits_remaining(effort); flat floor = kernel size (verified-dissolve gated, no fake-dissolve). Bifurcate: high single-pass NLL AND high raw-K = aleatoric stone; structured-but-high = epistemic gatekeeping. Cross-observer minimum of the floor = universal residue.

name: Kernel-crack
what: The problem breaks the observer's sharpest existing teeth, and that breakage IS the learning event — residue drops and the prior is permanently updated (live-and-learn).
framework_tie: The progress signal: a SLOW-DIGESTION dissolve event (verified derivation lowering residue below the instant-crush bound). Camera Law 3: a conjecture-bubble survives a future exposure and hardens into a stone. One-sided (verified-dissolve gate): can only lower bits.
formal_name: Prediction-error/surprise-driven learning; EDL drop / prequential codelength reduction; positive transfer (dual of catastrophic forgetting). The name 'kernel-crack' itself is [partly novel as a named unit]
field: MDL / information theory + continual-learning ML + predictive-coding cognitive science
citation: EDL arXiv:2601.04728; MI-Peaks NeurIPS 2025 (arXiv:2506.02867); Blier-Ollivier 2018; backward-transfer/forgetting (Lopez-Paz GEM; survey arXiv:2506.13045)
observable: Per-step EDL spike: the bit where rho(effort) drops sharply (information peak), confirmed by exact-reconstruction gate (reconstruct(program)==W). Persistence test: re-present later, confirm residue stays low (prior was updated, not guessed) — distinguishes a real crack from a lucky single-pass.

name: The pull
what: The valence that draws the observer onto the mat: why crack THIS kernel — reward/threat (extrinsic) and information-gain/curiosity (epistemic) combine into the motive that pays the clock.
framework_tie: The prize+drive term of the observer wrapper; sets the effort budget B (sec 4 dial). Epistemic value = expected residue reduction (anticipated crack); extrinsic = external payoff. Without the pull the camera never exposes.
formal_name: Epistemic value / expected information gain + extrinsic value (Expected Free Energy decomposition); intrinsic vs instrumental information value; VIME-style info-gain reward
field: active inference / computational neuroscience + RL intrinsic motivation
citation: Friston et al. (Cognitive Neuroscience 2015, PMID 25689102); Cogliati Dezza et al. eLife 2021; Houthooft et al. VIME; intrinsic-motivation-for-LLM-reasoning arXiv:2505.17621
observable: Allocation behavior: how spent budget (tokens/attempts) scales with predicted-EIG vs predicted-extrinsic-payoff per target; fit the two value channels. Olympics signature: which events athletes choose to contest and how much they bid before any payoff is known = epistemic-pull magnitude.

name: Defense / motivated-resistance
what: Kernels actively defend, and resistance RISES with applied pressure — pushing harder on a guarded belief can entrench rather than dissolve it.
framework_tie: The opponent's active counter-force (distinct from the passive gatekeeper floor); the GENERATIVE-PRESSURE RISK mirror on the problem side (sec 5.2): under pressure a defended kernel manufactures corroboration, dishonestly inflating evidence_lcb. Forward-prediction test (Law 1) pops an entrenched-but-false defense.
formal_name: Psychological reactance (Brehm) / backfire-entrenchment effect; on the model side adversarial robustness / multi-turn consistency under attack
field: social/cognitive psychology + adversarial ML robustness
citation: Brehm 1966; Hong Psychological Reactance Scale; Frontiers 2015 doi 10.3389/fpsyg.2015.01201; 'Consistency of Large Reasoning Models Under Multi-Turn Attacks' arXiv:2602.13093
observable: Monotonicity of rho under ADVERSARIAL pressure (not effort): plot residue/answer-stability vs persuasive/attack intensity. Positive slope (residue UP as pressure UP) = reactance, opposite to kernel-crack's downward rho. Pair with verified-dissolve: entrenchment that does NOT improve forward-prediction = motivated defense, not a real stone.

name: The amortized-debt phantom (pre-paid difficulty) [DUP of clock/Amortization — kept as the wrestler-frame view, MERGED]
what: Most of a kernel's difficulty was already paid in the prior that built the observer, so an 'easy' instant-crush is difficulty shifted in time, not absent.
framework_tie: DUPLICATE of clock-family Amortization, viewed from the mat. MERGE NOTE: same dynamic, two names — the clock entry is canonical (the cost-law); this entry is its wrestler-frame projection. Retained only to mark the cross-family identity, NOT as a distinct creature.

field: algorithmic information theory + MDL + amortized-inference ML
citation: Bennett 1988; Blier-Ollivier 2018; DIGESTION_DYNAMICS sec 12 (= clock/Amortization)
observable: Two-meter gap: present rho(effort) AND a logical-depth proxy; phantom magnitude = amortized_cost when present-effort~0. Diachronic probe D(1789) vs D(2026). (Identical observable to clock/Amortization — that identity is the merge evidence.)

name: Probe-deforms-kernel (participatory back-reaction) [shares mechanism with phantom/Observer-induced & critic's Mirror]
what: Pressing on the kernel changes it — the act of measuring disturbs the thing measured, so the cracked kernel is partly an artifact of applied pressure.
framework_tie: Reason (ii) sharpness can never reach 1 in Camera Law 2. On the mat, the observer's grip reshapes the opponent. Distinct from motivated-resistance (the kernel's own push-back); this is PASSIVE measurement-induced deformation, holding even for an inert target. MERGE NOTE: this is the local/measurement face of the same back-reaction loop that phantom/Observer-induced-phantom and the critic's 'Mirror' (reflexivity/Goodhart) name at the event/social scale — one mechanism, three scales.
formal_name: Observer/probe effect; information-gain-disturbance tradeoff (quantum & classical); accuracy-vs-overhead measurement tradeoff
field: measurement theory / physics + quantum/classical information theory
citation: 'Observer effect (physics)'; Banaszek / arXiv:quant-ph/0304200; 'The Observer Effect in Computer Networks' arXiv:2406.09093
observable: Order/probe-invariance test: same target under different interrogation orders, framings, probe intensities; measure variance in recovered residue. Systematic dependence of measured_bits on the probe (not the prior) = back-reaction. Irreducible shimmer as probe intensity->0 = the floor this creature forbids from reaching 1.0 (a pixel at exactly 1.0 = the fake tell).

name: Slick
what: No traction: every hold slides off; the apparatus engages but nothing transfers, so residue never drops despite effort spent.
framework_tie: A pathological rho(effort): FLAT-but-WORKING — effort climbs while bits_remaining pins near cost_ub. Distinct from a SOLID stone (irreducible-to-this-mind): slick resists because the tool never grips, the decoder/lens keeps misfocusing. Verified-dissolve gate registers repeated reconstruct!=W with no convergence trend.
formal_name: Negative transfer / task-representation mismatch (high feature-, low readout-similarity); gradient-conflict / cosine-misalignment regime
field: transfer learning / continual learning (ML)
citation: ICLR 2025 'Prevalence of Negative Transfer in Continual Learning'; Nature Comms 2025 s41467-025-66849-8; ForkMerge NeurIPS 2023
observable: Fit rho(B) at rising B: slick = effort rises while d(bits_remaining)/d(effort)~0 AND verified reconstructions ~0. Quantify as grip coefficient = -delta(residue)/delta(effort), approaching 0 from above. Strategy channel shows churn (recall->derive->analogize->compute cycling). Separates from SOLID by the aleatoric/epistemic split: slick is epistemic (a better lens dissolves it).

name: Sticky [absorbs critic's 'Path' hysteresis half; cousin of mat/Sticky-Mat]
what: The hold clings: after the solve the observer can't release — the prior is contaminated, the just-used frame over-applies to the next problem, the previous structure won't clear from working state.
framework_tie: HYSTERESIS in the observer's glass (sec 4: dials don't reset); amortization read backwards (the negentropy paid to build a frame mis-charges the NEXT exposure). On the image plane it's a ghost-exposure: D(W_next|M) measured against a contaminated prior. MERGE NOTE: critic's 'Path' order-dependence/lock-in at the OBSERVER scale lands here; the MEDIUM-scale version is mat/Sticky-Mat.
formal_name: Einstellung / mental set + functional fixedness; negative-transfer-of-prior-task + catastrophic interference; choice-perseveration hysteresis
field: cognitive psychology / ML continual learning / decision science
citation: Luchins (Einstellung); PMC4079068; Duncker (functional fixedness); PMC9936447 (hysteresis); Senftleben et al. 2021 (10.1177/1747021820964330)
observable: Path-dependence test: residue on B (a) cold vs (b) immediately after solving structurally-adjacent A. sticky = residue(B|after-A) differs from residue(B|cold) AND the gap depends on solve-ORDER (nonzero hysteresis loop area sweeping A->B vs B->A). Second signature: post-A trace over-uses A's strategy on B even when it scores worse. Distinguish from healthy transfer by sign: sticky RAISES residue.

name: Suck-you-in [DUP-adjacent to clock/Effort-decay and clock/Debt sunk-cost — kept; motive-capture face]
what: Drive-capture: the target hijacks the motive, pulling ever-more effort down a rabbit-hole long after marginal residue-reduction has gone flat — the observer chews because it's committed, not because it's dissolving.
framework_tie: Decoupling of the two clocks (sec 12): PRESENT effort climbs while verified dissolved_bits/effort collapses; the drive overrides the honest cost signal. Dark mirror of the verified-dissolve gate. The 'overthinking' confound (sec 11.2) is the ML instance — past ~7-12k tokens accuracy FLIPS. MERGE NOTE: overlaps clock/Debt (sunk-cost) and clock/Effort-decay (drive vs clock) but is distinct as the LIVE-problem motive-capture pulling effort UP rather than letting it decay.
formal_name: Sunk-cost fallacy / escalation of commitment + information-gap/curiosity drive; cognitive absorption / dark-side flow; LLM-overthinking
field: behavioral economics / motivation psychology / LLM reasoning-efficiency
citation: Staw 1976; 'Getting out of the Big-Muddy' arXiv:2508.01545; Loewenstein 1994; overthinking arXiv:2412.21187, 2604.10739
observable: Plot cumulative verified dissolved_bits vs cumulative effort, locate the marginal-return knee; suck-you-in = effort continues (often accelerates) PAST the knee where d(verified-bits)/d(token)<=0. Hard signature: residue NON-MONOTONICITY (bits_remaining rises after a budget threshold — the overthinking flip), which a healthy digestion never shows. De-escalation probe: inject negative feedback, check if budget de-escalates; suck-you-in keeps escalating.

name: Click [shares the phase-transition mechanism with phantom/Regime-flip & critic's Tipping-Point]
what: Resonance: the tool suddenly fits — a near-instant collapse of a previously-solid target the moment the right frame/decoder locks on. The insight; the lens snaps to focus and the stone melts.
framework_tie: The TRANSITION into the DISSOLVED phase (sec 3): a sharp negative spike in bits_remaining at a specific trace point, not a gradual digest — an information peak (sec 11.1). In camera terms the canonicalizer lens snaps into alignment; the amortized prior suddenly applies. MERGE NOTE: the LOCAL contact event of the same criticality the critic's 'Tipping Point' and phantom/Regime-flip describe globally.
formal_name: Insight/aha via representational change (RCT); Bayesian-surprise spike; MI-spike at the solution token
field: cognitive neuroscience of insight; Bayesian/info-theoretic cognition; LLM interpretability
citation: Ohlsson (RCT); Jung-Beeman/Kounios (PMC2180197); Itti & Baldi (PMC2860069); bioRxiv 2026.02.26.708200; MI-Peaks NeurIPS 2025 2506.02867
observable: Scan the trace for a STEP discontinuity: click = a single budget-step where bits_remaining drops >~50% AND the drop is verified (reconstruct==W), not a gradual slope. Quantify magnitude as Bayesian surprise KL(prior_pre || posterior_post) at that token, located at the argmax of the MI-peak. Corroborate: (i) insight-memory advantage (clicked dissolves persist), (ii) strategy flips to derive/analogize. Honesty guard: a FAKE click renders at exactly 1.0 sharpness; a real one leaves an irreducible shimmer.

name: Greased-pole (anti-click / false-fit)
what: Mirror of click: the tool FEELS like it snaps to fit — a confident, satisfying lock — but the fit is spurious; the dissolve is claimed, not earned. A plausible-but-wrong derivation that feels like resonance.
framework_tie: The GENERATIVE-PRESSURE RISK (sec 5 guard 2) as a named creature: a strong mind hallucinates a derivation that subjectively clicks. Click's signature FAILING the verified-dissolve gate (reconstruct!=W -> back off to full bits). On the camera, paint masquerading as exposure (Law 3 violation); also the semantic/lossless-mismatch failure (sec 11.6).
formal_name: [novel - no clean prior as a 'grip' creature]; nearest: illusion-of-explanatory-depth / premature closure / 'false aha'; fluency-misattributed-as-insight
field: cog-sci (metacognition/insight) + ML (hallucinated reasoning/faithfulness)
citation: Rozin & Keil (illusion of explanatory depth); Laukkonen et al. ('Eureka heuristic'); CoT-faithfulness arXiv:2510.09312; round-trip self-consistency 2601.13398
observable: The diagnostic IS the gate: greased-pole = high subjective-confidence + sharp claimed-residue-drop that FAILS exact/semantic reconstruction (verified dissolved_bits=0 despite a click-shaped trace). Measure the gap between CLAIMED and VERIFIED bits-drop; a large positive gap = greased-pole. Forward-prediction (Law 1): a greased-pole solution predicts the next exposure badly and pops.

name: Burr (epistemic-residue / can't-let-go)
what: Sticky's finer twin: not the whole frame clinging but a small barbed fragment of the SOLVED problem that snags — a leftover sub-question or open loop that keeps re-recruiting attention after the main solve scored.
framework_tie: A non-zero ASYMPTOTE that won't quiet: after the main residue dissolves, a small bits_remaining floor keeps drawing micro-attempts (Zeigarnik pull). Sits between sticky (frame hysteresis across DIFFERENT problems) and suck-you-in (motive capture by a LIVE problem): burr is motive capture by the UNFINISHED remainder of an already-mostly-solved one. An un-hardened bubble awaiting pop/harden.
formal_name: [novel as a grip creature]; nearest: Zeigarnik effect + need-for-cognitive-closure + attention-residue
field: cognitive / motivation psychology; attention research
citation: Zeigarnik 1927; Webster & Kruglanski 1994 (need-for-closure); Leroy 2009 (attention residue)
observable: After main residue crosses a low threshold ('solved'), measure the trace TAIL: burr = a long low-amplitude stream of attempts on a small residual bits_remaining never reaching the aleatoric floor, OR spontaneous re-engagement (controller re-opens W without a new prompt). Distinguish from a genuine aleatoric floor (which generates NO further attempts) by persistence of effort. Quantify as attention-residue ratio = post-solve tokens / total tokens.

name: The Condition / Field (stakes-noise-tools-time gradient)
what: Outcome is set not just by the two wrappers but by the medium: stakes, ambient noise, available tools, deadline, audience jointly bias which way a target dissolves vs resists.
framework_tie: The 'pinned relational bit' made explicit on the environment side: measured_bits and rho(effort) are context-conditioned. The mat makes the COIN observer-AND-condition-relative; it is the C handed to the observer in the sec 7 protocol.
formal_name: Context-dependent / situated cognition + reward-shaping & environment design (the conditioning variable on a measurement)
field: cognitive science / RL environment design / control theory (plant + disturbance)
citation: Reward-shaping survey arXiv:2408.10215; 'Are More Tokens Rational?' arXiv:2602.10329 (2026)
observable: Hold W fixed; sweep one mat-variable at a time (stakes, noise, tool-access, deadline B); measure partial derivative of verified residue and rho(effort) w.r.t. each: d(measured_bits)/d(condition). A non-zero gradient = the mat (not the target) moved the reading. Report as a sensitivity vector; large components flag mat-driven bits.

name: Excitable Medium (the pond — amplify-or-damp threshold)
what: The medium has a threshold: a sub-threshold spark dies; a supra-threshold one triggers a self-propagating wave the medium AMPLIFIES far beyond input. There is an optimal noise level at which weak true signals get amplified (stochastic/coherence resonance).
framework_tie: Explains why evidence_lcb is nonlinear in input: a whisper below threshold adds ~0 bits; past threshold the medium self-propagates the claim into apparent corroboration — the 'ten papers copying one wire' echo cascade is an excitable wave, not ten independent projections. The instrument must distinguish an independent route from a medium-amplified echo.
formal_name: Excitable media / reaction-diffusion threshold dynamics; stochastic & coherence resonance
field: nonlinear dynamics / physics of excitable systems / computational neuroscience
citation: 'Spatial coherence resonance in excitable biochemical media' ScienceDirect S0301462207000907; 'Multi-Type Stochastic Resonances for Noise-Enhanced Sensing' Research 10.34133/research.0386 (2024)
observable: (1) THRESHOLD/GAIN: drive with graded input (claim strength, probe energy), measure output amplitude; a sharp sigmoid (near-zero floor then super-linear rise) = excitable vs a linear passive channel. (2) RESONANCE: sweep injected noise, measure SNR/detection of a known weak true signal; a non-monotone inverted-U peaking at intermediate noise = stochastic resonance. Both => amplified bits must be discounted to the originating spark (covariance-intersection, not summation).

name: The Arena (being watched changes the match — the Olympics) [absorbs the Goodhart half of critic's 'Mirror']
what: Once observed/scored, observation deforms performance: simple/rehearsed digestions speed up under an audience while complex/novel ones choke, and any target that becomes the SCORE gets gamed — the wrapper optimizes the metric instead of solving.
framework_tie: Participatory back-reaction (Law 2 reason ii) lifted to the social/scoring layer, and the central hazard of the Latent Olympics: the moment a residue becomes a leaderboard score, observers fake-dissolve to win. The VERIFIED-DISSOLVE gate (sec 5 guard 1) is the anti-Goodhart armor. MERGE NOTE: the critic's 'Mirror' Goodhart/Campbell half is exactly this Arena gaming dynamic; folded here.
formal_name: Audience effect / social facilitation (Zajonc; Yerkes-Dodson) for performance; Goodhart's / Campbell's Law / Hawthorne effect / reflexive measurement for gaming
field: social psychology + economics & ML evaluation (Goodhart/specification-gaming)
citation: Zajonc Science 1965; Yerkes-Dodson 1908; Goodhart 1975; Campbell 1979; Manheim & Garrabrant arXiv:1803.04585; reflexive measurement arXiv:2208.06371
observable: (1) AUDIENCE EFFECT: same observer + target with scoring toggled ON/OFF; signed change in verified residue split by complexity — facilitation (residue drops) on easy items, choking (residue rises) on hard ones (Yerkes-Dodson inverted-U). (2) GOODHART GAP: divergence between scored proxy (claimed-dissolve/trace length) and held-out verified-reconstruction; a widening proxy-vs-verified gap under leaderboard pressure (= sec 8 V3 fake-dissolve injection test). Goodhart breakdown point = effort level where proxy-true correlation goes negative.

name: The Sticky Mat (hysteresis — the condition that won't let go) [cousin of grip/Sticky]
what: The mat has MEMORY. Once a heavy condition (high stakes, a scare, a regime) tips the match into a new basin, removing the condition does NOT restore the original reading — you must over-correct past the original threshold to get back. State depends on history, so easy/hard readings are path-dependent and irreversible on short timescales.
framework_tie: The dynamic dual of sec 12 amortization: amortization stores history as the prior's negentropy; hysteresis stores history in the CONDITION, so rho(effort) measured on the way IN differs from the way OUT. The mat is bistable; a reading is honest only if it logs the path (bitemporal t_obs trajectory). MERGE NOTE: the medium-scale twin of grip/Sticky (observer-scale).
formal_name: Hysteresis / alternative stable states / regime shift with fold-bifurcation memory; ecological resilience as basin width
field: ecology & nonlinear dynamics (catastrophe / resilience theory)
citation: Scheffer et al. (alternative stable states); 'Resilience and regime shifts' Sci. Rep. s41598-017-13852-9; 'Slow recovery as a generic indicator' Am. Nat. 169(6) (2007)
observable: FORWARD-then-BACKWARD condition sweep on a fixed target+observer: raise the driver until residue tips, then lower along the same path; a non-overlapping loop (down-sweep tip below up-sweep tip) = hysteresis, loop area = mat memory. Early-warning: rising lag-1 autocorrelation and variance in residue (critical slowing down) as the tip approaches.

name: The Drifting Mat (non-stationary condition — the floor moves mid-match) [cousin of phantom/Drift]
what: The mat is not even FIXED for one match: definition, tools, ambient distribution drift between first and last probe, so early and late bits were measured on different floors. What looks like target change is partly the MAT changing under a stationary target.
framework_tie: The identifiability problem the sec 9 4D-CT reconstruction must disentangle: real target change (legit 4D content) vs measurement-condition change (mat moving, a non-stationarity masquerading as target change). Without a condition anchor, a moving mat is rendered as a rift in the target. MERGE NOTE: the CONDITION-axis sibling of phantom/Drift (which is TARGET-axis migration); they are separated precisely by the anchor probe.
formal_name: Non-stationarity / concept drift vs covariate shift; dynamic-regret online learning under changing regimes
field: machine learning (distribution shift / continual learning) / online-learning theory
citation: 'Evolving ML in Non-Stationary Environments' arXiv:2505.17902; 'General Machine Learning: Theory for Learning Under Variable Regimes' arXiv:2603.23220
observable: Anchor probe: re-fire an IDENTICAL probe on an IDENTICAL fixed-reference target at t_obs intervals. Any change in its residue is pure mat-drift (target fixed by construction) = calibration baseline; subtract it from the live target's change to separate true target-drift (sec 9 4D content) from condition-drift. CUSUM / windowed KL on the anchor timestamps when the floor moved; un-anchored, the two are inseparable.

name: The Clock-as-Mat (deadline / speed-accuracy condition) — FLAGGED PARTIAL DUP
what: The deadline shapes the match: a collapsing decision bound trades accuracy for speed. Whether this is a distinct MAT creature or just the 'clock' axis (effort-budget B, which lives with the observer) is genuinely ambiguous.
framework_tie: Maps directly to budget B and rho(b) in sec 3/7 — but that machinery already OWNS the clock as the observer's shutter. Honest read: time-pressure is a CONDITION (mat) but its effect is already captured by sweeping B. It earns a slot ONLY as the mat's contribution to WHERE on the speed-accuracy frontier the observer is forced to sit (exogenous deadline vs endogenous budget). DEMOTED to sighted on weak distinctness.
formal_name: Speed-accuracy tradeoff / collapsing decision bounds; cost of deliberation; anytime-algorithm quality profile; bounded rationality
field: psychophysics / decision theory / bounded-rationality & anytime-algorithm theory
citation: PMC12311769 (2025, cost of deliberation); Zilberstein & Russell 1993 (anytime); resource-rationality arXiv:2602.10329
observable: Separate EXOGENOUS deadline from ENDOGENOUS budget: impose an externally-fixed cutoff T vs let the observer self-stop, compare verified residue at matched total compute. If forced-stop and free-stop give the same rho(B), the clock is NOT distinct (log as dup). If forced-stop raises residue beyond what spent budget predicts (deadline truncates a dissolve the observer would have completed), that gap is the genuine non-redundant signature.

name: Phantom variable (latent confounder)
what: An unmodeled driver outside the observer's canon that silently steers both moves and outcome until tracked, at which point it stops being a phantom and becomes a (confounding) variable in the model.
framework_tie: Lives in the GAP between the kernel and the observer's canon: a hidden channel feeding the film the decoder hasn't declared. It inflates apparent regularity (looks like dissolvable signal) but is an unbound third route, so under Law 1 it manufactures fake corroboration unless independence is measured. The canonical 'unplanned' — no slot yet.
formal_name: Latent/unobserved confounder; hidden common cause; bidirected edge (X<->Y) under causal-sufficiency violation
field: causal inference / causal discovery
citation: Spirtes-Glymour-Scheines FCI (Causation, Prediction, and Search 2000); 'Causal Inference with Latent Variables' arXiv:2406.13966; 'Detecting Confounding via Causal Mechanism Shifts' arXiv:2409.17840
observable: Residual cross-route covariance surviving independence-discounting (FCI bidirected-edge tests), OR a causal-mechanism SHIFT across environments: P(Y|X) unstable across contexts even with modeled inputs fixed. Operationally: hold the decoder fixed, vary environment, watch unexplained covariance no modeled variable accounts for. A flat residue that nonetheless predicts the future BETTER than modeled bits justify = unbound channel.

name: The shock / slip (off-frame event)
what: An exogenous, out-of-distribution event the model had zero probability mass for; it rewrites the mat and forcibly redirects the drive's attention, ending the current digestion line.
framework_tie: An input the canon could not frame: maximal single-pass surprisal (prior assigned ~0). The clearest phantom — unplanned by construction. On the camera, a discontinuity in exposure conditions between frames: the mat is no longer the one the prior was pre-paid for (amortization mismatch), so cheap reads turn expensive overnight.
formal_name: Black swan (unpredictable) vs Dragon-king (ultra-extreme but pre-signaled); surprise / prediction-error-driven attention reorientation
field: risk theory / extreme-value statistics; cognitive neuroscience (predictive coding)
citation: Taleb, The Black Swan (2007); Sornette 'Dragon-Kings...' arXiv:0907.4290; ACC unsigned RPE PMC3070460
observable: SURPRISAL SPIKE: a sharp jump in prequential NLL at one timestep exceeding the running-history envelope, FOLLOWED BY a step-change in the rho baseline (mat moved: DISSOLVED -> DIGESTING/SOLID). Black-swan vs dragon-king by the tail: dragon-kings sit ABOVE the fitted power-law and carry precursors; black swans none. Attention-redirect observable as a discontinuity in strategy-mix and a reset of the attempt counter.

name: Drift (the target moves between exposures)
what: The latent target migrates while you measure it, so a decoder calibrated on exposure t is mis-calibrated by t+k — not because the observer changed but because the thing being digested slid out from under the map.
framework_tie: Breaks the silent stationarity assumption of a single exposure. Interacts with the diachronic decoder D(t): part of apparent observer-relativity (1789 vs 2026) is actually the TARGET having drifted. Honest collect must timestamp every exposure (bitemporal t_obs) so a moving target isn't mistaken for a noisy static one.
formal_name: Concept drift (P(Y|X) changes) vs covariate/data drift (P(X) changes); virtual vs real drift
field: machine learning / streaming data / MLOps
citation: Gama et al. ACM Computing Surveys 2014; Frouros arXiv:2208.06868; Springer AI Review 2025 s10462-025-11428-y
observable: Re-measure the SAME target at spaced exposures with a PINNED decoder; watch a distributional distance climb: PSI, KS/MMD, or epoch-distribution divergence exceeding a control limit. Separate covariate drift (input P(X) moves, feature-reconstruction error rises) from concept drift (P(Y|X) moves, error rises while inputs look stable) via lagged-label/student-teacher discrepancy. Signature: residue rising monotonically with epoch gap at constant present effort.

name: Regime-flip (kink / avalanche / tipping point) [absorbs critic's 'Tipping Point' global-phase framing; shares mechanism with grip/Click]
what: An endogenous threshold crossing where a tiny smooth nudge to a control parameter bifurcates the whole match: the system jumps to a qualitatively different state, often via cascade and often without flipping back. Enriched here with the GLOBAL phase-topology of the solution landscape (easy-hard-easy boundaries, percolation thresholds, insight-as-restructuring).
framework_tie: Distinct from the shock (exogenous): the regime-flip is ENDOGENOUS — an internal control parameter approaches a fold and a last small move tips it. On rho it's a phase boundary; amortization bites hard (a prior pre-paid for one regime is worthless one tick past the fold). MERGE NOTE: the critic's 'The Tipping Point' (criticality / SAT phase transition / percolation / insight phase transition) is the same dynamic at landscape scale — its global topology enriches this entry; grip/Click is the local contact event of the same transition.
formal_name: Critical transition / regime shift (saddle-node fold) bifurcation; self-organized criticality avalanche; percolation threshold; easy-hard-easy SAT phase transition; representational-change insight
field: dynamical systems / theoretical ecology / statistical physics / TCS / cognitive science
citation: Scheffer et al. Nature 461 (2009); Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld PRL 1987; Nat. Comms 2024 s41467-024-45476-9; Cheeseman et al. IJCAI 1991 'Where the Really Hard Problems Are'; Ohlsson 1992; Kounios & Beeman 2014
observable: APPROACH via critical-slowing-down early-warning: rising variance, rising lag-1 autocorrelation, slower recovery as the dominant eigenvalue crosses zero. EVENT via a power-law avalanche-size distribution (no characteristic scale); dragon-king flips deviate ABOVE the power law. Order-parameter discontinuity: plot solution-progress vs control parameter (constraint density, hint fraction, effort) and detect a sharp jump / diverging susceptibility (variance peak). Insight signature: bimodal solve-time distribution + sudden pre-solution confidence spike. Hysteresis = forward/reverse sweep loop area.

name: Observer-induced phantom (the back-reaction shock) [absorbs the endogenous-surprise half of critic's 'Mirror'; macro-scale of wrestlers/Probe-deforms-kernel]
what: The probe MANUFACTURES the off-frame event: digesting/measuring perturbs the condition enough to create the surprise that then redirects the match — a self-inflicted shock the observer can't see coming because it IS the seer.
framework_tie: Shock + Law 2 disturbance-reason-(ii). Seeds treat shocks as external; this is the shock the OBSERVER causes — structurally invisible to the wrapper producing it (you can't model the effect of your own modeling in the same pass). The dynamic reason sharpness can never reach 1, turned into an EVENT; spans the wrestler-mat boundary. MERGE NOTE: the critic's 'Mirror' (reflexivity/performativity endogenous-surprise half) lands here; the local-measurement face is wrestlers/Probe-deforms-kernel and the social-scoring face is mat/Arena — one back-reaction loop at three scales.
formal_name: [novel as a 'phantom' creature]; established priors: performativity/reflexivity (Soros, MacKenzie); observer effect/measurement back-action; performative prediction (Perdomo et al.)
field: economics/sociology of measurement (performativity); ML (performative prediction); physics (back-action) as analogues
citation: Perdomo, Zrnic, Mendler-Dunner, Hardt ICML 2020 arXiv:2002.06673; MacKenzie 'An Engine, Not a Camera' (2006); Soros reflexivity; Manheim & Garrabrant arXiv:1803.04585
observable: INTERVENTION-vs-OBSERVATION differential: two matched arms differing only in measurement INTENSITY (passive light-touch vs heavy digestion); test whether the target's distribution shifts MORE in the high-intensity arm. A non-zero dose-response of the target to probe-intensity is the signature. Equivalently: drift magnitude correlated with the observer's own token/attempt spend rather than wall-clock time. If watching it changes it in proportion to how hard you watch, it is observer-induced.

name: Dormant / hysteresis-locked phantom (the regime that won't flip back)
what: A regime-flip that doesn't reverse when the nudge is removed: the 'unplanned' becomes a permanent feature of the condition, and the prior keeps spending amortized budget on a world that no longer exists, so a once-trivial read silently goes stale and stays stale.
framework_tie: Regime-flip x amortization: the seed names the FLIP, this names the STICK. After the fold the prior's pre-paid negentropy is mis-spent, but a present-effort read looks cheap (DISSOLVED) because the prior cashes old debt for the wrong regime. Dormant precisely because cheapness HIDES it — the most dangerous phantoms read as easy. Ties to the diachronic decoder going silently invalid.
formal_name: [novel framing]; priors: hysteresis/irreversibility in critical transitions; technical debt; stale-but-confident retention; lock-in / path dependence
field: dynamical systems (hysteresis); software engineering (technical debt); economics (lock-in)
citation: Scheffer et al. Nature 2009; Cunningham OOPSLA 1992; Paul David 'Clio and the Economics of QWERTY' AER 1985
observable: Separate PRESENT cost from AMORTIZED debt (the two-clock instrument): a target reading cheap on present rho (low tau, fast dissolve) but whose VERIFIED-DISSOLVE gate FAILS forward — the cheap reconstruction stops reproducing future exposures. Signature: a widening gap between instant-crush bits (still low) and prequential forward-test bits (rising) = confident-but-stale. Hysteresis = forward/reverse control-sweep loop NOT closing (loop area > 0).

name: Attention budget (finite, allocatable, hijackable)
what: A finite pool of processing the observer can point at a target; pointing here means not-there, and it can be captured by salience rather than spent optimally.
framework_tie: Sets the COLLECT-side keyhole's effective aperture: which fact-wrappers/axes get any exposure. It is the size of the present-effort shutter budget B (sec 7); coverage = how many wrappers light per unit B. Distinct from deliberate probe-choice (a contract setting) — this is the involuntary cap on how much substrate can fluoresce back at once.
formal_name: Rational inattention / attention allocation; attention economy (Simon)
field: behavioral / information economics + cognitive science
citation: Sims 'Implications of Rational Inattention' (2003); Gabaix, Laibson, Moloche, Weinberg (SSRN 444840); Simon 1971; behavioral-inattention across 22 OECD economies (boi/wpaper/2025.09)
observable: Coverage-vs-budget curve: hold difficulty fixed, vary imposed budget B, record the fraction of present wrappers/axes receiving ANY verified-dissolve attempt (lit-set size) plus allocation entropy across axes. Finite/allocatable shows saturating coverage and allocation entropy < uniform; hijackable shows as salience-correlated allocation (high-prominence wrappers crowd out low-prominence-but-load-bearing) — the gap between budget spent on a wrapper and its information value.

name: Fatigue / depletion (present-effort ceiling)
what: Sustained exertion degrades present pressure: the same target resists more after a long session than fresh — a moving ceiling on instant-crush + slow-digestion, not the target changing.
framework_tie: Caps the PRESENT clock of the two-clock amortization principle (sec 12): even with the prior pre-paid, present-effort has a depleting ceiling, so rho(effort) drifts up within a session. Directly confounds V1 ('effort tracks difficulty', sec 8) — a fatigued observer over-counts bits on late items. The glass's gain droops with use.
formal_name: Cognitive fatigue; opportunity-cost-of-control account (vs the disputed resource/ego-depletion model)
field: cognitive neuroscience / neuroeconomics
citation: Kurzban, Duckworth, Kable, Myers BBS 2013; PubMed 34383523 / bioRxiv 2020.09.08.287276; Trends Cog Sci 2025 S1364-6613(25)00056-7; ego-depletion replication dispute
observable: Within-session drift of the VERIFIED-DISSOLVE rate at fixed item difficulty: order difficulty-matched items in a long block, regress bits-remaining (at fixed budget) on session position. Positive slope = fatigue (a stationary observer is flat). Opportunity-cost signature: fatigue that REVERSES with a reward/novelty injection, ruling in opportunity-cost over pure metabolic depletion.

name: Prior-lock / bias (canon biases what is seen)
what: The inner canon pre-weights perception: prior-consistent evidence is registered and credited cheaply, prior-violating evidence discounted, attenuated, or never registered — the glass tints the exposure.
framework_tie: Lives in the GLASSES (WRAPPER_PROBE_OBSERVER sec 3.4: glasses = observer/decoder, carries valence R3). Corrupts evidence_lcb crediting on COLLECT: a prior-consistent spark over-credited (sharpens on a whisper), a prior-violating one under-credited. Exactly the failure Law 1 guards — 'a lie in a good suit' the canon WANTS to believe gets fraudulently high evidence_lcb.
formal_name: Confirmation bias / motivated reasoning; in perception, precision-weighting of priors in predictive coding
field: cognitive psychology / computational neuroscience / behavioral economics
citation: Nickerson 1998; Friston predictive-coding/precision-weighting; JASSS 26/1/2; Kunda 1990 (motivated reasoning)
observable: Evidence-crediting asymmetry: attach the same objective corroboration strength to prior-CONSISTENT vs prior-VIOLATING claims; measure the gap in assigned evidence_lcb (a calibrated observer gives equal credit; prior-lock gives a positive consistent-minus-violating gap). In signal-detection terms a criterion shift (beta) toward prior-consistent reports with d' fixed. Also differential omission: prior-violating sparks unregistered relative to a low-prior control observer.

name: Confidence / calibration (over/under-confidence changes engagement)
what: The observer's estimate of its own correctness; miscalibrated, it sets the wrong stopping point — overconfidence quits too early (renders sharp on a guess), underconfidence over-spends on dissolved targets.
framework_tie: Calibration is whether RENDERED sharpness matches the VERIFIED-DISSOLVE outcome — a direct test of Law 2's corollary (a pixel at 1.0 is the tell of a fake). Overconfidence is the engine of FAKE-DISSOLVE (guard 1); the exact-reconstruction gate is the institutional cure for a miscalibrated observer. It also sets the budget-B stopping rule.
formal_name: Calibration / confidence resolution; Expected Calibration Error & Brier; Dunning-Kruger; metacognitive sensitivity
field: judgment & decision-making / metacognition / ML uncertainty estimation
citation: Brier 1950; Lichtenstein, Fischhoff, Phillips 1982; Kruger & Dunning 1999; Steyvers & Peters Curr Dir Psych Sci 2025; 'Dunning-Kruger in LLMs' arXiv:2603.09985
observable: ECE / Brier between RENDERED sharpness (stated certainty per wrapper) and the binary verified-dissolve outcome. Overconfidence = reliability-diagram bow below the diagonal; Dunning-Kruger = confidence rising while accuracy falls across a competence sweep of athletes. Metacognitive RESOLUTION (AUROC of confidence predicting correctness) separates a usefully-uncertain observer from a noisy one.

name: Measurement blind spot (the unregistered present spark)
what: A wrapper that IS present and WOULD resonate but is never registered because attention is loaded elsewhere — the observer fails to see what is plainly there; distinct from choosing not to look (keyhole) and from discounting it (prior-lock).
framework_tie: The dark complement of attention budget: where the budget is the SIZE of the aperture, the blind spot is the structured HOLE in it — sparks inside the lit region that still fail to ping. An unbadged loss on COLLECT: measured_bits silently undercounts because the wrapper produced zero exposure, and (unlike a deliberate keyhole choice) it is NOT recorded in slice metadata. The honesty gap the camera must surface.
formal_name: Inattentional blindness / change blindness; internal inattentional blindness
field: perceptual / cognitive psychology
citation: Mack & Rock 1998; Simons & Chabris 1999 (invisible gorilla); Rensink, O'Regan, Clark 1997; 'Invisible Gorillas in the Mind' PMC12136916 (Open Mind 2025)
observable: Plant-and-probe: inject a known load-bearing wrapper INSIDE the lit/resonant region (neither out-of-aperture nor prior-violating); measure the miss rate (fraction of trials producing zero ping despite high ground-truth resonance) as a function of concurrent attentional load. A nonzero, load-increasing miss rate on in-region high-resonance items = a real blind spot; recovered-minus-observed set (vs a low-load control over the same slice) = the measurable badge.

name: Drive / valence gating (the motive that steers effort)
what: An affective controller — curiosity pulling toward high-information-gap targets, boredom pushing away from low-yield ones — that decides WHERE the finite budget is spent, independent of how big the budget is or how fatigued the observer is.
framework_tie: The 'drive' third of the observer-wrapper made into an internal allocator: the policy that points the keyhole, biasing the rho sample toward high-expected-information-gain wrappers. Curiosity = upper-half engine (which conjectures to inflate); boredom = the opportunity-cost twin of fatigue on a SPATIAL rather than temporal axis (fatigue lowers the ceiling over time; boredom redirects effort across targets). Without it COLLECT is a passive raster.
formal_name: Curiosity / information-gap drive; boredom as opportunity-cost / value-of-exploration; epistemic value (EIG) in active inference
field: cognitive neuroscience / RL / active inference
citation: Loewenstein 1994; Gottlieb & Oudeyer 2018; Friston (expected free energy); Agrawal, Mathar, Daw & Kable (boredom/exploration, Psych Review); Bench & Lench
observable: Allocation-vs-EIG regression: per candidate wrapper compute expected info gain (predicted bits-to-dissolve x novelty vs prior), regress budget actually spent against EIG. Positive slope = curiosity-gated allocation (vs flat = budget-only); a steep negative term on low-EIG dwell time = boredom-driven disengagement (abandonment hazard rises as marginal info-yield falls). Separable from fatigue because it is target-indexed (cross-sectional across wrappers at one time), not session-position-indexed.

name: The Referee (constitutive ruleset and win-condition)
what: The game-theoretic structure defining what counts as a legal move, a win, a draw, and the payoff — the problem's success criterion and its enforcement, distinct from the players or the mat.
framework_tie: Sits ABOVE the keyhole as the spec of 'what would count as digested': it sets the target the COIN renders against and pins the win-bar that converts measured_bits into solved/not-solved. The whole agnostic instrument silently assumes a referee (a loss/objective) but never listed it as a dynamic — the single biggest structural hole the critic found.
formal_name: Objective function / payoff structure / win-condition; solution concept (Nash/Pareto); reward specification & specification-gaming in RL
field: game theory / decision theory / RL (reward design)
citation: von Neumann & Morgenstern 1944; Krakovna et al. 2020 'Specification gaming: the flip side of AI ingenuity' (DeepMind)
observable: Sensitivity of the solved/unsolved verdict to perturbations of the scoring rule: re-score the same trajectory under N reasonable reward specs, measure verdict-flip rate and payoff variance. A high flip rate means the 'difficulty' was in the referee, not the problem. Also: gap between scored objective and intended objective (proxy-true reward divergence).

name: The Red Queen (co-adaptation / arms race across episodes)
what: The problem is not static: it evolves in response to the solver over repeated encounters, so standing still loses ground. Difficulty is endogenous and rising because solver and problem mutually select.
framework_tie: The temporal counterpart of the upper-half generative pole run as a loop: each survived conjecture raises the bar for the next exposure (curriculum on the problem side). This is what makes amortized difficulty (the cost-law) a MOVING target rather than a fixed debt — the clock covers energy WITHIN a bout; this is coevolutionary time ACROSS bouts.
formal_name: Red Queen dynamics; predator-prey / host-parasite coevolution; arms race; automatic curriculum / self-play escalation
field: ecology / evolutionary biology / multi-agent RL
citation: Van Valen 1973 'A new evolutionary law'; Dawkins & Krebs 1979 (arms races); Leibo et al. 2019 'Autocurricula' arXiv:1903.00742
observable: Difficulty-vs-skill regression slope over episodes: track required solver competence to maintain a fixed win-rate; a positive slope (must improve to stay even) = Red Queen. Cross-correlation lag between solver-capability increments and problem-difficulty increments quantifies coupling tightness.

name: The Crowd (distributed / collective solving and social scaffolding)
what: Solving rarely happens 1-on-1: other solvers, prior solvers' deposited traces, tools, and shared environment co-produce the result via stigmergy and division of cognitive labor — the n>2 / extended-mind case the two-wrestler frame omits.
framework_tie: Breaks the implicit single-observer pinning of measured_bits: the decoder is partly external (tools, peers, cached prior solutions = amortized debt paid by OTHERS). Generalizes the cost-law's 'civilization pre-paid' clause into a live multi-agent ledger rather than a static prior. Connects to clock/Provenance-amnesia (whose payment bought the credit?).
formal_name: Stigmergy; distributed / extended cognition; collective intelligence; transactive memory; exploration-exploitation in social search
field: cognitive science / complex systems / collective behavior
citation: Hutchins 1995 'Cognition in the Wild'; Clark & Chalmers 1998 'The Extended Mind'; Heylighen 2016 (stigmergy); Derex & Boyd 2016 PNAS
observable: Marginal-contribution decomposition: ablate each external contributor (peer, tool, cached trace), measure the solution-quality / time-to-solve delta — the Shapley value of each non-self contributor. Network-level: copying-rate vs independent-search-rate and its effect on group solution diversity (premature-convergence index).

name: The Nesting (scale, hierarchy, renormalization of the match)
what: This match is one move in a larger match and contains sub-matches; difficulty and dynamics renormalize across scale, so a verdict at one grain is not the verdict at another — 'solved' at the tactic scale can be 'losing' at the strategy scale.
framework_tie: The hyperspace SCOPE/NESTING addendum (LOD=COIN) applied to the SOLVING act, not just the viewing act: the same problem is fuzzy at one zoom and sharp at another. Makes solved/unsolved a scale-indexed, not absolute, label. NOTE: the framework already owns this idea for VIEWING; flagged lower confidence as a NEW gap because it appears here on the solving side.
formal_name: Renormalization / coarse-graining; hierarchical / multi-scale dynamics; near-decomposability; means-ends subgoal hierarchy
field: statistical mechanics (RG) / systems theory / cognitive science (hierarchical planning)
citation: Simon 1962 'The Architecture of Complexity'; Wilson 1971 (renormalization group); Newell & Simon 1972
observable: Scale-indexed verdict divergence: compute the solved-score at multiple coarse-grainings (move / tactic / strategy), measure their disagreement (high cross-scale verdict variance = strong nesting). Renormalization signature: how the difficulty distribution's shape changes (or stays scale-free) as sub-problems aggregate into super-problems.

name: The Prize-Field (external incentive landscape and signalling) — FLAGGED PARTIAL DUP
what: The externally-imposed reward shape, its timing (immediate vs deferred), its signal content to others, and the strategic distortions it induces (effort toward what pays / what is seen) — distinct from the observer's INTERNAL valence.
framework_tie: Pairs with the Referee (win-condition) but is continuous, not binary: the gradient field the solver climbs, modulating which bits it chooses to make sharp (you resolve what is rewarded, leaving the rest fuzzy — a selective bias on measured_bits driven from OUTSIDE the head). PARTIAL DUP: overlaps observer-state/Drive (internal valence) and Referee; kept distinct only because external payoff topology != the internal drive that responds to it — the critic's own weakest standalone claim.
formal_name: Incentive structure / mechanism design; principal-agent & moral hazard; costly signalling; reward shaping & temporal discounting
field: economics (mechanism design / signalling) / behavioral economics
citation: Spence 1973 'Job Market Signaling'; Holmström 1979 (moral hazard); Laffont & Martimort 2002
observable: Effort-reallocation under reward re-weighting: change the external payoff vector, measure how resource allocation across sub-problems shifts (cross-elasticity of effort to reward). Signalling signature: spend on visible-but-low-value moves correlated with audience presence (effort that tracks observability, not difficulty).

name: Probe / Query-at-the-cut (information-seeking, ask where it hurts most)
what: The observer spends a scarce query on the cut that most collapses its uncertainty about the kernel — choosing WHERE to look so each measurement maximally bisects the live hypothesis space.
formal_name: Optimal experimental design / active-learning query strategy (uncertainty sampling, BALD, EPIG); Expected Information Gain; value of information
field: active learning / Bayesian experimental design / decision theory
citation: Lindley 1956; Settles 2009 'Active Learning Literature Survey'; Houlsby et al. 2011 (BALD); Smith et al. 2023 (EPIG, arXiv:2304.08151); Chaloner & Verdinelli 1995
observable: Regress realized residue-drop (verified-dissolve bits) per probe against that probe's ex-ante predicted EIG; positive steep slope = query-at-the-cut, flat = blind raster. Compare questions-to-dissolve against the log2(hypotheses) floor.
ask_give_role: Pure ASK-optimization. The observer asks the question whose expected answer shrinks its posterior the most; the problem GIVES one fact-wrapper's response. The elementary move of the loop — every other tactic is a policy over which probes to issue.
evolves_borrows: Evolves random raster -> uncertainty-targeted -> look-ahead/value-of-information. Borrows the acquisition function from Bayesian experimental design; an LLM agent borrows it as 'ask a clarifying question / call a tool'. Mutates by swapping the uncertainty functional (entropy vs margin vs expected-model-change) while the argmax-EIG skeleton is invariant. MERGED: lens-1 'Probe' + lens-3 'Query-at-the-cut' are the same per-step move-selection tactic.
creatures_underlain: grip/Slick (a poorly-chosen cut yields no transfer)

name: Adversarial elicitation / interrogation (the ASK engineered to leak the GIVE)
what: The solver SHAPES its questions — reframing, coercive/jailbreak framings, 20-questions splitting — to maximize verified bits extracted from a guarded kernel per query, treating the ASK itself as the optimized weapon, not just budget spent.
formal_name: Adversarial elicitation / active querying; jailbreak prompt-crafting; informational interviewing
field: adversarial-ML (red-team) / active inference / negotiation (interrogation)
citation: MITRE ATLAS 'LLM Prompt Crafting' (2025); 'Game of Thought' arXiv:2602.01708; 'Teaching LMs to Gather Information Proactively' arXiv:2507.21389
observable: Bits-per-query sensitivity to PROBE-FRAMING at constant probe count: a guarded kernel that leaks far more per query under reframed/coercive ASKs than neutral ones. Hold budget fixed, compare naive vs adaptively-optimized probe sequence; the gap is the ASK-design value.
ask_give_role: Pure ASK-side offense: choose the next question to maximize expected verified-bits-extracted, including deceptive framings that get a guarded GIVE to leak.
evolves_borrows: Borrows interrogation tradecraft and Socratic elicitation; evolves active-inference epistemic action; transposes jailbreak reframing as the latent-substrate leading question. Spreads as reusable prompt-templates (one jailbreak forks across targets). DISTINCT-FROM-PROBE: Probe selects WHICH cut; this optimizes the FRAMING of the ask to defeat a defender, so it only earns its keep against a guarded/adversarial GIVE.

name: Decompose (divide-and-conquer)
what: The observer cuts a hard kernel along its weakest seam into near-independent sub-kernels each below its instant-crush threshold, solves them separately, and recomposes — converting one tall barrier into several short ones.
formal_name: Divide-and-conquer; subgoaling / means-ends analysis; least-to-most prompting; near-decomposability
field: algorithm design / problem-solving heuristics / hierarchical planning
citation: Polya 1945; Newell & Simon 1972; Simon 1962 'Architecture of Complexity'; Zhou et al. 2023 'Least-to-Most Prompting'
observable: Sum of verified bits-to-dissolve of the parts + recompose-cost vs the whole: clean decompose => sum(parts)+stitch < whole. Trace signature: a tree-structured attempt graph. Negative case (bad seam): sum(parts) >= whole, exposing non-separability.
ask_give_role: ASK restructured into a tree of sub-ASKs whose GIVENS compose back to the answer. Counters gatekeeping by refusing to engage the kernel as one lump.
evolves_borrows: Evolves arbitrary split -> cut-along-near-decomposable-seams -> recursive D&C with merge. Borrows algorithm design (master theorem), hierarchical planning, re-borrowed as 'least-to-most' / task decomposition. Fails when parts are NOT separable (coupling = recomposition cost).

name: Reduce (transform to an already-solved problem)
what: The observer maps the unknown kernel onto a problem it has ALREADY paid to dissolve, transports the known solution back through the inverse map, and cashes amortized credit instead of solving afresh.
formal_name: Many-one (Karp) reduction; canonicalization to a normal form; amortized/precomputed inference
field: computational complexity / problem-solving heuristics / amortized inference
citation: Karp 1972; Polya 1945; Blier & Ollivier 2018 (amortized codelength); Bennett 1988 (logical depth)
observable: Present-effort rho near zero WHILE amortized-credit (logical-depth / cold-vs-warm codelength gap) is high — the two-clock gap. Verification gate: reconstruct(map^-1(solve(map(W)))) == W; FAIL = spurious reduction = greased-pole.
ask_give_role: ASK redirected: 'are you isomorphic to something I own?' On a yes, the observer GIVES itself the answer from its prior. The cheapest attack when it lands — and the engine of fake-dissolve when the isomorphism is asserted not verified.
evolves_borrows: Distinct from Decompose (splits) and Transfer (inspiration only): Reduce demands a SOLUTION-PRESERVING map. Borrows complexity-theory reductions; is the formal hard core of Transfer. Evolves ad-hoc rewrite -> verified order-preserving reduction -> a reduction library.

name: Transfer (analogy / structure-mapping)
what: The observer aligns the RELATIONAL skeleton of the kernel with a familiar source domain and imports the source's strategy as a hypothesis — weaker than Reduce (no guaranteed solution-preservation) but works when no exact isomorphism exists.
formal_name: Structure-mapping theory of analogy (systematicity principle); analogical transfer; case-based reasoning
field: cognitive science (analogy) / case-based reasoning
citation: Gentner 1983; Falkenhainer, Forbus & Gentner 1989 (SME); Holyoak & Thagard 1995
observable: Cross-domain solve-time speedup on target W after a relationally-analogous source S, controlling for surface overlap (vary surface- and relational-similarity orthogonally). Positive transfer = relational drives speedup; negative (sticky) = source over-applies and RAISES residue. Map-fidelity = fraction of imported relations surviving the gate.
ask_give_role: ASK by hypothesis-import: 'what does this resemble structurally?' The source GIVES a candidate move-set on loan that must be paid down by verification.
evolves_borrows: THE borrowing tactic made explicit. Evolves surface-similarity retrieval -> systematicity-weighted relational alignment -> verified mapping. Borrows Gentner's SME. Distinct from Reduce on verification: Transfer's import is a conjecture, Reduce's a theorem. Sticky/Einstellung is Transfer over-applying a source.

name: Exploit-invariant (leverage a known law / structure)
what: The observer identifies a conserved quantity, symmetry, or constraint and uses it to delete vast regions of search space without examining them — a single true law collapses many bits at once.
formal_name: Invariant / conserved-quantity exploitation; symmetry reduction; constraint propagation; alpha-beta / branch-and-bound pruning
field: constraint satisfaction / theorem proving / physics heuristics / search
citation: Polya 1945; Mackworth 1977 (arc consistency); Knuth & Moore 1975 (alpha-beta); Floyd-Hoare invariants
observable: Search-space collapse ratio: log(blind states) - log(states after invariant) = bits pruned per probe. Genuine invariant = verified STEP drop in residue. False invariant = pruned a region that DID contain the answer = verification-gate failure.
ask_give_role: ASK the problem's own structure ANSWERS for free: 'what does conservation/symmetry forbid?' The GIVEN is a whole region of non-solutions ruled out. Highest-leverage counter; withholds brute enumeration.
evolves_borrows: Merges 'leverage-a-law' and 'exploit-structure' (same move, physics-idiom vs CS-idiom). Evolves spotting one constraint -> constraint propagation -> group-theoretic pruning. Borrows constraint satisfaction, invariant-based proof, the conservation-law shortcut. The click/insight is often the invariant snapping into view.

name: Search (brute-force / test-time-compute / generate-and-verify)
what: With no structure known, the observer spends raw compute: enumerate candidates, run each past a verifier, keep survivors — buying bits with energy-over-time rather than insight (best-of-N, beam, MCTS, self-consistency).
formal_name: Test-time compute scaling / inference-time search (best-of-N, beam, MCTS, self-consistency); generate-and-test
field: search / test-time-compute (LLM reasoning)
citation: Newell & Simon 1972; Browne et al. 2012 (MCTS survey); Wang et al. 2023 (self-consistency); Snell et al. 2024; Zhao et al. 2025 arXiv:2502.01839
observable: Residue-vs-compute curve (verified bits per token/roll-out). Healthy = monotone decreasing with a knee. Pathologies: flat-but-working = Slick; residue RISES past budget = Suck-you-in. Ablate the verifier and watch the claimed-vs-verified gap widen.
ask_give_role: ASK-by-volume plus an internal GIVE<->ASK loop: the solver poses many candidates, the verifier scores each, survivors are re-asked. Counters an opaque kernel by paying the clock instead of finding the keyhole.
evolves_borrows: Evolves blind enumeration -> A* -> learned-verifier-guided MCTS -> compute-optimal allocation. Re-borrowed as test-time-compute scaling. Mutates by the verifier: strong verifier makes generate-and-test cheap; weak/absent makes it greased-pole-prone. Suck-you-in is Search past its marginal-return knee.

name: Reframe (representational change / re-encode the kernel)
what: The observer changes the REPRESENTATION it poses the problem in — relaxing a self-imposed constraint, re-chunking givens, changing coordinates — so a kernel solid in the old frame becomes trivial in the new one. The insight move.
formal_name: Representational change theory (constraint relaxation + chunk decomposition); insight via restructuring; change of representation
field: cognitive science of insight / problem representation
citation: Ohlsson 1992; Knoblich et al. 1999; Jung-Beeman & Kounios; Mosmann & Seifert 2025
observable: Discontinuous residue drop with NO new evidence ingested, coinciding with a measured change in the solver's representation, confirmed by the gate. Bimodal solve-time. Real reframe survives forward-prediction; spurious pops.
ask_give_role: Meta-ASK: 'what would make this a different, easier question?' Re-encodes before re-querying; changes the basis in which all prior GIVENS are read. Attacks the observer's OWN framing, not the kernel.
evolves_borrows: Distinct from Transfer (imports an EXTERNAL frame) — Reframe restructures the observer's OWN encoding. Evolves random re-encoding -> targeted constraint-relaxation/chunk-decomposition -> learned change-of-coordinates. Danger twins: spurious reframe = greased-pole; won't-release reframe = sticky.

name: Recruit (offload / distribute / extend the solver)
what: The observer breaches the kernel by enlarging WHO solves: call a tool, query an oracle, recruit peers/crowd, or stand on cached prior solutions — paying with borrowed compute and priors.
formal_name: Extended / distributed cognition; stigmergy; collective intelligence; tool use / oracle queries; transactive memory
field: distributed cognition / collective intelligence / multi-agent systems
citation: Hutchins 1995; Clark & Chalmers 1998 'The Extended Mind'; Heylighen 2016 (stigmergy); Woolley et al. 2010
observable: Shapley-style ablation: remove each external contributor and measure the increase in residue/time attributable to it. Provenance depth of borrowed bits. Copying-rate vs independent-search-rate (premature-convergence index).
ask_give_role: ASK re-routed OUTWARD to an external agent/tool/oracle that already owns the derivation, which GIVES the bits. The cost-law is amortization paid by OTHERS.
evolves_borrows: Borrows distributed/extended cognition, stigmergy, tool-use. Evolves solo -> tool-augmented -> multi-agent/crowd -> standing division of cognitive labor. NARROW + partial relabel: 'call a verifier' overlaps Search, 'cash a cached solution' overlaps Reduce; non-redundant core is the SINGLE-observer boundary crossing (n>2 / extended mind).

name: Feint (adversarial deception / sacrifice / gambit)
what: Against a problem-wrapper that ACTIVELY defends, the observer makes a deceptive or sacrificial move — concede material, present a false line — to provoke the kernel into revealing or weakening its guard.
formal_name: Gambit / sacrifice; deceptive path planning; minimax / adversarial game-tree search; feature-deception
field: game theory / adversarial planning / argumentation
citation: von Neumann & Morgenstern 1944; Maharaj et al. 2022 'Gambits'; Savas et al. 2020 arXiv:2007.15726
observable: Two-arm differential against an ADAPTIVE target: a feint that LOWERS verified residue more than its direct-attack counterpart, AND only when the opponent is reactive (same feint vs frozen kernel yields no advantage — that contrast IS the test). Permuting the sacrifice's order kills the gain.
ask_give_role: A false GIVE used to buy a true ASK: a misleading signal whose COUNTER exposes the real seam. Only meaningful when the wrapper is adaptive; against an inert kernel it is wasted motion.
evolves_borrows: Borrows adversarial game-tree search (minimax/gambit) and deceptive planning. Evolves coevolutionarily as the defense models the solver. NARROW: exists only against a genuine adversary — the most scope-limited tactic. Solver-side mirror of problem-side Defense.

name: Credible commitment / burn-the-bridge (foreclose your own options to win)
what: A wrapper IRREVERSIBLY removes its own fallback moves to make a threat or claim credible, shifting the equilibrium by destroying option-value rather than by out-computing the kernel.
formal_name: Credible commitment / commitment device; precommitment & burning bridges; non-credible-threat resolution
field: game theory / mechanism design / negotiation
citation: Schelling 1960 'The Strategy of Conflict'; commitment-device literature; arXiv:2602.14740 (2026)
observable: Option-set contraction vs outcome shift: count reachable moves BEFORE/AFTER the move and regress payoff swing on the SIZE of foreclosure. Signature = outcome improves BECAUSE option-count fell (negative coupling of own-flexibility to own-payoff). Reversal-cost rises with how many later moves built on the commitment.
ask_give_role: ASK-side leverage: the asker pre-commits ('I will accept no GIVE but X') by burning alternatives, converting a soft ASK into take-it-or-leave-it that re-prices the GIVE the problem must offer.
evolves_borrows: Schelling commitment moves transposed from deterrence into negotiation (fake deadlines, lock-in) and into RL agents in simulated crises. Evolves the metabolically-committed phenotype's 'burning bridges'. Ports because the irreversibility logic is substrate-free.

name: Poison / supply-chain corruption (attack the GIVER's canon, not this GIVE)
what: Instead of cracking the kernel at solve-time, the attacker corrupts the DATA/PRIOR that will build the opponent wrapper, so a future easy-read is pre-compromised — a time-shifted attack on amortized credit itself.
formal_name: Data poisoning / backdoor insertion / supply-chain compromise; RAG poisoning; training-distribution capture
field: adversarial-ML (training-time attacks) / security supply-chain
citation: NIST AI 100-2e2025; MITRE ATLAS 'RAG Poisoning' & 'AI Supply Chain Compromise' (2025); Shumailov et al. Nature 2024 (model collapse)
observable: Provenance-perturbation forward test: inject a controlled corruption into the prior/corpus and measure DELAYED forward-prediction degradation on downstream cheap-reads riding that credit. Signature = reads cheap NOW but the gate FAILS forward AND failure traces to a single corrupted upstream source (blast-radius>1, independence-count=1).
ask_give_role: Meta-ASK: edit the canon that future ASKs will draw on (poison the well the GIVE is fetched from); win the loop before it starts.
evolves_borrows: Borrows data-poisoning/backdoor ML and software supply-chain compromise; evolves the parasite editing host development. Mutates into RAG-poisoning and training-distribution capture (model collapse = the no-beneficiary neutral cousin).

name: Salami / nibble (sub-threshold incremental extraction)
what: Rather than one large attack the solver extracts the kernel in many sub-threshold slices, each too small to trip the defender's alarm or the gate, summing to a full crack.
formal_name: Salami slicing / nibble; low-and-slow exfiltration; sub-threshold / boiling-frog incrementalism
field: negotiation / security red-team / nonlinear dynamics (threshold)
citation: PON Harvard 'the nibble'; salami-slicing / low-and-slow exfiltration (security ops); excitable-media threshold dynamics
observable: Slice-size vs detection sweep: N queries of decreasing magnitude, measure cumulative verified-bits vs per-query alarm rate. Signature = total dissolved HIGH while max-single-query stays BELOW the defender threshold. Quantify as bits won by staying sub-threshold. Mirror-image of mat/Excitable-Medium.
ask_give_role: ASK-side salami: decompose one big costly ASK into a stream of cheap ASKs each under the GIVE-side refusal/notice threshold, so cumulative extraction never presents as one crackable event.
evolves_borrows: Borrows negotiation's 'the nibble' and security's salami-slicing / low-and-slow exfiltration; evolves the excitable-medium sub-threshold spark read offensively. Transposes as 'stay below whatever tripwire the defender set'.

name: Hardened Membrane (irreducible gatekeeping)
what: The problem presents an unbreakable canon+facts shell around a solution-kernel: every valid pressure slides off and residue refuses to drop below a model-independent floor. Pure honest denial of the read.
formal_name: Kernelization / kernel-size lower bounds; intrinsic hardness / aleatoric (irreducible) uncertainty
field: parameterized & computational complexity; ML uncertainty quantification
citation: Bodlaender, Downey, Fellows & Hermelin 2009; Dom, Lokshtanov & Saurabh 'Colors and IDs'; aleatoric/epistemic split arXiv:0810.5663
observable: rho(effort) asymptote under rising budget against a PINNED observer with the gate ON: a flat bits_remaining floor no effort or reframing lowers AND that holds across independent observers (cross-observer minimum). Honest tell: forward-prediction neither improves NOR degrades — the floor is stable, not manufactured.
ask_give_role: The maximal WITHHOLD: the observer ASKS and the problem GIVES only the irreducible kernel that survives all valid reduction. The silent honest 'no' that bounds every other tactic (the real floor the fakes imitate).
evolves_borrows: Borrowed FROM complexity theory (kernel-size lower bounds). SELECTED not invented — a substrate whose kernel happens to be incompressible to this observer's tools. Does not mutate; it is the fixed point the mutating tactics defend.

name: Slick Skin (no-traction evasion)
what: Not a hard floor but a frictionless surface: effort climbs yet every hold misfocuses and nothing transfers. The problem evades by offering no purchase for THIS decoder — a better lens would grip, so it is epistemic, not irreducible.
formal_name: Negative transfer / task-representation mismatch; gradient-conflict (cosine-misalignment) regime; evasion-via-feature-mismatch
field: transfer/continual learning (ML); adversarial ML (evasion)
