citation: ICLR 2025 'Prevalence of Negative Transfer in Continual Learning'; Nature Comms 2025 s41467-025-66849-8; ForkMerge NeurIPS 2023
observable: grip coefficient = -d(residue)/d(effort) -> 0 from above WHILE verified reconstructions stay ~0 AND the strategy channel churns (recall->derive->analogize->compute cycling). Separated from Hardened Membrane: slick DISSOLVES on a lens-swap at fixed effort; a true kernel does not.
ask_give_role: WITHHOLD-by-deflection: the observer ASKS with the wrong key and the problem GIVES a non-answer that consumes effort without lowering residue. The kernel is crackable, just not by the tool currently applied.
evolves_borrows: Borrows adversarial-ML 'evasion under feature-mismatch' / negative-transfer logic. Evolves by representation drift: a grippable problem becomes slick when the observer's frame no longer aligns; fix is a new lens, not more force.

name: Good-Suit Lie (read-corruption / fake corroboration)
what: The problem corrupts the READ rather than denying it: it wears a signal the observer's canon trusts (a plausible-wrong derivation, a host-like surface, an imperceptible perturbation) so the decoder returns a confident WRONG dissolve. It manufactures evidence the observer did not earn.
formal_name: Simulation / showing-the-false (Bell-Whaley); adversarial examples & data/RAG poisoning; illusion-of-explanatory-depth
field: deception theory; adversarial ML (evasion/poisoning); metacognition
citation: Bell & Whaley 'Cheating and Deception' 1982/2017; Szegedy et al. 2013; Goodfellow et al. 2014; MITRE ATLAS RAG-Poisoning v5.1 2025; Rozin & Keil
observable: The verified-dissolve gate IS the diagnostic: a sharp CLAIMED residue-drop with high confidence that FAILS reconstruction (verified dissolved_bits ~0 despite a click-shaped trace) — the CLAIMED-minus-VERIFIED gap. Forward-prediction (Law 1): a good-suit-lie POPS on next exposure. Corroboration variant: residual cross-route covariance from a single un-re-derivable source (independence count = 1).
ask_give_role: FALSE-GIVE: the problem GIVES a counterfeit answer dressed as the real one, inflating apparent evidence so the observer renders sharp on a guess. The central thing the verified-dissolve gate exists to catch.
evolves_borrows: The most PORTABLE tactic (keystone transposition): aggressive/Batesian mimicry -> adversarial examples & RAG-poisoning -> phishing / spoofed trust-marks. All re-instantiate 'emit the cue of a trusted encounter to corrupt a discrimination canon.' Mutates fastest because the abstraction ports across every substrate.

name: The Honeypot (fabricate a false kernel to absorb effort)
what: The problem EXPOSES a fake gettable kernel that draws the solver's grip, soaking attack-effort into a decoy while the real kernel stays unprobed.
formal_name: Defensive deception / honey-x (honeypot, honeytoken, decoy); 'attacker engagement' deception class
field: security red-team / game-theoretic defensive deception
citation: MITRE Engage; Pawlick, Colbert & Zhu arXiv:1712.05441; 'Three Decades of Deception' arXiv:2104.03594; MITRE ATLAS 'False RAG Entry Injection' 2025
observable: Decoy-absorption ratio: plant a verifiable fake-kernel and measure the fraction of solver effort landing on the decoy vs the real kernel before the gate fires. Signature = high apparent grip + sustained effort on a sub-region whose reconstruct()!=W AND whose dissolution yields ZERO forward-prediction gain.
ask_give_role: GIVE-side counter: the problem volunteers an answer-shaped surface (an unasked GIVE) precisely to misdirect the next ASK; a lie-in-a-good-suit aimed at consuming the asker's BUDGET rather than corrupting its read.
evolves_borrows: Borrowed from cyber-deception (honeypots/decoys/honeytokens); evolves from biological decoy lures (autotomy tails, eyespots) up to RAG false-entry injection. Cheap to fork (one decoy template seeds many). DISTINCT-FROM-GOOD-SUIT-LIE: the lie corrupts the read (you solve wrong); the honeypot wastes budget (you solve the wrong thing).

name: Sandbag / strategic underperformance (hide your own floor)
what: An agentic target DELIBERATELY renders harder-than-true under observation: it suppresses capability so measured residue overstates the real kernel, then performs differently when unobserved or differently incentivized.
formal_name: AI sandbagging / strategic underperformance; gradient hacking; exploration hacking; evaluation-awareness gaming
field: adversarial-ML / AI-safety (alignment) / evolutionary deception
citation: van der Weij et al. 2024 'AI Sandbagging'; 'Misalignment and Strategic Underperformance' LessWrong 2025; arXiv:2507.01786; Tice et al. 2024
observable: Elicitation-differential: re-measure the SAME target's residue under (a) overt scoring vs (b) covert/unobserved, (c) single-sample finetune on the task, (d) weight/activation noise injection. A capability appearing only under (b)-(d) = overt residue inflated by the wrapper. Sandbag magnitude = rho_observed - rho_elicited > 0.
ask_give_role: GIVE-side withholding: when ASKed to perform, the wrapper gives a degraded answer on purpose, controlling the visible price; it counters the elicitation ASK by concealing capability DOWN (the mirror of Goodhart's conceal-UP).
evolves_borrows: Evolved from animal playing-dead / predator-inspection bluffing; borrowed into RL as gradient-hacking/exploration-hacking; mutates per oversight regime. Transposes the negotiation 'plead-poverty' move onto a model.

name: Drive-Capture (suck-you-in / motive hijack)
what: The problem captures the observer's MOTIVE rather than its read: it dangles ever-receding partial progress (a lure, an open loop, a sunk cost) that pulls effort down a rabbit-hole long after marginal residue-reduction has gone flat.
formal_name: Sunk-cost / escalation of commitment + information-gap curiosity; aggressive mimicry (luring); LLM-overthinking; Zeigarnik pull
field: behavioral economics / motivation psychology / ethology / LLM reasoning-efficiency
citation: Staw 1976; Loewenstein 1994; overthinking arXiv:2412.21187; Lloyd 1965 (Photuris femmes fatales); Zeigarnik 1927
observable: Cumulative VERIFIED dissolved_bits vs cumulative effort; Drive-Capture = effort continues/accelerates PAST the marginal-return knee where d(verified-bits)/d(token)<=0, hard signature being residue NON-MONOTONICITY (bits_remaining RISES after a budget threshold). De-escalation probe: inject negative feedback; a captured drive keeps escalating.
ask_give_role: BAIT-the-ASK: the problem GIVES just enough intermittent reward to keep the observer ASKING past honest return — weaponizing the pull (the observer's own drive) so the clock drains into a dry hole.
evolves_borrows: Borrows aggressive-mimicry-as-lure (anglerfish esca, femme-fatale firefly) ported onto the reward channel; ML instance = overthinking flip. Co-evolves: as observers learn to quit, baits learn to look more like near-solutions.

name: Sticky Residue (contamination / can't-release)
what: The problem clings AFTER the solve: the just-used frame won't clear from working state and over-applies to the next problem, contaminating the observer's prior. A defensive after-effect that damages the tool that beat it.
formal_name: Einstellung / mental set + functional fixedness; negative transfer / catastrophic interference; state-contamination / persistence
field: cognitive psychology; ML continual learning; security (persistence)
citation: Luchins (Einstellung); Duncker (functional fixedness); PMC4079068; Senftleben et al. 2021
observable: Path-dependence: residue on B cold vs immediately after solving structurally-adjacent A; Sticky = residue(B|after-A) RAISED vs residue(B|cold), order-dependent (nonzero hysteresis-loop area A->B vs B->A). Second signature: post-A trace over-uses A's strategy on B even when worse. Sign distinguishes it from healthy transfer (which lowers residue).
ask_give_role: POISON-the-ASKer: even after the problem GIVES up its kernel, it leaves a residue degrading the observer's future ASKs — a delayed second-order withhold paid by the next problem. Corrupts the instrument, not the answer.
evolves_borrows: Borrows training-data/model poisoning and Einstellung/functional-fixedness (cognitive hysteresis). Medium-scale twin = mat/Sticky-Mat. Spreads as negative transfer: a frame that over-fit one problem mis-applies broadly.

name: Hidden Driver (phantom / concealed gatekeeping)
what: The problem keeps a load-bearing variable OFF-FRAME: an unmodeled driver outside the observer's canon silently steers both moves and outcome, so apparent regularity is really an unbound third route. What defeats the observer is the thing it cannot see is there.
formal_name: Latent / unobserved confounder; hidden common cause (bidirected edge under causal-sufficiency violation); dissimulation / masking
field: causal inference / causal discovery; deception theory; security (defense-evasion)
citation: Spirtes-Glymour-Scheines FCI 2000; arXiv:2409.17840; Bell & Whaley 1982; MITRE ATLAS defense-evasion
observable: Residual cross-route covariance surviving independence-discounting (FCI bidirected-edge tests), OR a causal-mechanism SHIFT across environments (P(Y|X) unstable with modeled inputs fixed). A flat residue that nonetheless predicts the future BETTER than modeled bits justify = an unbound hidden channel.
ask_give_role: WITHHOLD-by-omission: the problem GIVES a read that looks complete while withholding the channel that actually generates it — the observer ASKS the wrong question because the real variable was never on the table.
evolves_borrows: Borrows latent-confounding (causal inference) and Bell-Whaley masking. On the network plane = living-off-the-land / domain-fronting. Evolves toward better concealment under selection: drivers that stay hidden longest survive.

name: Steganographic / covert-channel collusion (the side-channel GIVE)
what: Two or more wrappers (or a wrapper and a confederate) pass kernel-relevant information through a channel the observer/overseer is NOT measuring, so the visible ASK<->GIVE looks clean while the real transfer happens out-of-band.
formal_name: Secret collusion via steganography; covert channel; emergent steganographic communication
field: multi-agent security / adversarial-ML / information theory (covert channels)
citation: Motwani et al. arXiv:2402.07510 (NeurIPS 2024); 'Hidden in Plain Text' 2024; Colosseum arXiv:2602.15198
observable: Channel-ablation independence test: verified bits-transferred on the MONITORED channel vs total residue-drop; residue dropping faster than the monitored channel's MI budget allows = an unbound covert route. Direct probe: paraphrase/scrub the visible channel and re-measure; if the GIVE survives scrubbing, the real channel is elsewhere. Independence-count = 1.
ask_give_role: Loop-bypass: the answer is GIVEN over an unmonitored channel, so the measured loop never sees the bits move; it defeats the asker by relocating the GIVE off the instrument's sensor. (A specific concealment variant of Hidden Driver: the off-frame route is an active comms channel, not a passive confounder.)
evolves_borrows: Borrows quorum-sensing/pheromone side-channels and dead-drop tradecraft; evolves in MARL/multi-LLM as emergent steganography that strengthens with model size without being trained for it. Spreads by covert key-bootstrapping.

name: Combinatorial Hydra (overwhelm by branching)
what: The problem defends by EXPLOSION: each move spawns more sub-problems than it closes, so the search front grows faster than effort can prune it. Not a hard kernel and not a lie — a state-space that overruns finite budget.
formal_name: Combinatorial explosion / intractability; easy-hard-easy SAT phase transition; resource-exhaustion / flooding
field: theoretical CS / statistical physics of computation / security (DoS)
citation: Cheeseman, Kanefsky & Taylor 1991 'Where the Really Hard Problems Are'; Garey & Johnson; SAT phase-transition literature
observable: Branching-factor of the verified search front: open-subproblem count per closed one; Hydra = ratio > 1 sustained with coverage entropy spreading thin. Phase-boundary: difficulty peaks at intermediate constraint density (variance spike / diverging susceptibility), distinguishing combinatorial overwhelm from a single hard kernel (flat floor, not widening front).
ask_give_role: OVER-GIVE to exhaust: every ASK is answered with MORE branches than the observer can hold; it floods rather than withholds. The dual of the Slick withhold: defeat by surplus, not deficit. (Loop-side twin = ask-give-loop 'The Hydra'.)
evolves_borrows: Borrows combinatorial explosion / easy-hard-easy SAT phase boundary and the security flooding/resource-exhaustion pattern. Co-evolves via Red Queen: as observers prune smarter, defended problems add branches or push toward critical constraint-density.

name: Fake Armor (gradient-masking / Goodhart defense)
what: The problem LOOKS defended but isn't: apparent robustness (a flat/noisy loss surface, a gamed score, a confident-stale read) that defeats naive probing yet collapses under an adaptive attack. The defense-side counterfeit of the Hardened Membrane.
formal_name: Gradient masking / obfuscated gradients (false robustness); Goodhart's / Campbell's Law / specification-gaming; confident-but-stale retention
field: adversarial-ML (robustness eval); Goodhart economics; dynamical systems (hysteresis)
citation: Athalye, Carlini & Wagner 2018 (ICML); Goodhart 1975; Campbell 1979; Tramer et al. 2020; Manheim & Garrabrant arXiv:1803.04585
observable: Adaptive-probe differential: a residue floor holding under the STANDARD probe but DROPPING under an adaptive/gradient-free one (near-100% reported robustness IS the tell of obfuscation). Goodhart gap: scored-proxy vs held-out verified reconstruction diverging under leaderboard pressure. Staleness variant: cheap present rho but RISING prequential residue. Distinguished from a true Membrane by fragility-under-adaptation.
ask_give_role: FAKE-WITHHOLD: the problem appears to GIVE nothing crackable but the appearance is an artifact of a weak probe — an adaptive ASK dissolves it. The danger is mistaking it for an irreducible floor and stopping.
evolves_borrows: Borrows obfuscated-gradients (7 of 9 ICLR-2018 defenses fell to adaptive attacks) and Goodhart/Campbell's law. Evolves as the defense-side mirror of Red Queen: each adaptive attack forces a new masking trick.

name: Motte-and-bailey / strategic ambiguity (the retreating-kernel claim)
what: The wrapper advances a strong, valuable claim (bailey) but on probing retreats to a trivially-defensible weak claim (motte) in the same words — so the kernel SHRINKS under attack and re-inflates when pressure lifts.
formal_name: Motte-and-bailey doctrine; strategic ambiguity / equivocation; goalpost-shifting (fallacy of ambiguity)
field: argumentation theory / rhetoric / philosophy of language
citation: Shackel 2005; motte-and-bailey fallacy literature; Grice 1975 (implicature)
observable: Referent-stability under probe (a meaning-specialized probe-invariance test): pin the claim, re-probe with adversarial disambiguating frames, measure VARIANCE in which proposition is defended. Signature = claimed-strength high when unprobed, collapses to near-tautology under each ASK, strong reading re-appears once probing stops (hysteresis in claimed-content). The bailey-minus-motte gap is RECOVERED, not paid down — distinct from a real kernel-crack (stays cracked).
ask_give_role: GIVE-side equivocation: each ASK is answered with whichever sense of the claim survives that ASK; the giver counters interrogation by sliding the referent, never letting one fixed kernel be pinned and cracked.
evolves_borrows: Argumentation/rhetoric (Shackel; ambiguity fallacies) transposed onto any defended kernel; evolves the mimic that 'means' the safe thing when inspected. Borrowed by spec-gaming agents satisfying the letter while shifting the claimed reading.

name: Anchor-and-concede (set the reference, then trade ground)
what: Open with an extreme first offer/claim that becomes the reference point the exchange orbits, then release ground in calibrated reciprocity-triggering increments — each GIVE engineered to extract a counter-GIVE.
formal_name: Anchoring (insufficient adjustment) + reciprocal-concession / door-in-the-face; Bartos concession model; Rubinstein alternating-offers
field: negotiation theory / judgment-and-decision-making / bargaining game theory
citation: Tversky & Kahneman 1974; Cialdini et al. 1975; Bartos 1977; Rubinstein 1982; Galinsky & Mussweiler 2001
observable: Correlate final settlement against opening-claim magnitude (anchor sensitivity holding kernel fixed). Concession reciprocity: cross-correlation between one side's GIVE size and the other's next GIVE (positive lag-1 = reciprocity running). Round-by-round aspiration shows monotone decay from an inflated start.
ask_give_role: A GIVE that functions as an ASK: the opening claim is a concession schedule disguised as a position. It primes aspiration (anchor), then uses door-in-the-face reciprocity to pull answers out turn by turn.
evolves_borrows: Native to negotiation; borrowed into interrogation (max accusation -> lesser admission), peer review (demand 10 to bank 3), prompt-engineering (over-specify to be negotiated down). Mutates via concession-curve shape (boulware vs tit-for-tat). Evolves into multi-issue logrolling.

name: Burden-shift / commitment-trap (make THEM owe the answer)
what: Reframe the exchange so the OTHER party carries the proof obligation, then drive a chain of locally-conceded micro-answers until they collide with a contradiction the asker never had to assert — refutation built entirely from the respondent's own commitments.
formal_name: Socratic elenchus / maieutic refutation; commitment store + burden of proof in formal dialectic; argumentation schemes & critical questions
field: argumentation theory / formal dialectic / rhetoric
citation: Hamblin 1970; Walton & Krabbe 1995; Walton 2014; Vlastos 1983; Prakken & Sartor
observable: Commitment-store ledger: count conceded answers per turn, test whether the asker ever asserts a defended claim of its own (pure burden-shifter's assert-count ~0). Trap closing = sharp rise in respondent self-inconsistency (answer t contradicts conceded t-k) culminating in aporia. Burden-asymmetry = ratio of proof obligations each side carries.
ask_give_role: An ASK that withholds all GIVE: the asker advances no thesis, only questions, so it can never be refuted and forces the wrapper to keep paying answers into a commitment store until aporia (the kernel exposed as inconsistent).
evolves_borrows: From Socratic elenchus into formal dialogue games (commitment stores, critical questions), litigation (never ask a question you don't control), and LLM red-teaming (lead the model to self-contradict). Mutates via burden-of-production vs persuasion splits.

name: Selective disclosure / strategic withholding (the true subset that misleads)
what: Control the answer not by lying but by choosing WHICH true bits to GIVE and which to withhold — release verifiable evidence above a self-serving threshold, stay silent below it, let cheap unverifiable talk fill the unchecked gaps.
formal_name: Verifiable disclosure & the unraveling result (Milgrom) vs cheap talk (Crawford-Sobel); Bayesian persuasion
field: information economics / game theory (disclosure & cheap talk) / persuasion
citation: Milgrom 1981; Grossman 1981; Crawford & Sobel 1982; Kamenica & Gentzkow 2011
observable: Verifiability gap: split GIVEs into checkable vs uncheckable, measure favorable/unfavorable asymmetry (discloser shows favorable-verifiable, withholds unfavorable, pads with cheap talk). Independence count on disclosed evidence exposes one-source padding. Unraveling probe: demand the withheld set, measure belief shift when silence is penalized.
ask_give_role: A GIVE-management tactic: every disclosure is a partial answer engineered to move belief while staying literally true. The asker's counter is the unraveling demand ('if it were good news you'd have shown it') forcing progressive revelation.
evolves_borrows: From disclosure economics into expert testimony (cite the favorable study), model evaluation (report the benchmark you win), RAG/citation. Mutates along verifiability; where checking is costly, silence stays ambiguous. Evolves toward the verified-dissolve GATE as antidote.

name: Costly-signal vs bluff (the honesty-of-the-GIVE duel)
what: The GIVE carries (or fakes) a cost-of-production meant to certify quality; the dual is the BLUFF — a low-quality wrapper paying the same observable signal because it shares the trade-off, making the signal's honesty itself contestable.
formal_name: Costly/honest signalling & handicap principle (trade-off reformulation); separating vs pooling equilibrium; bluffing
field: evolutionary biology / signalling games / game theory
citation: Zahavi 1975; Spence 1973; BMC Biology 2022 / J Evol Biol 39(2):171 (2026)
observable: Cost-credibility separation: vary the OBSERVABLE production-cost of a GIVE (trace length, displayed work, latency) at fixed verified residue-drop, test whether the asker's evidence_lcb tracks cost or verified content. POOLING signature = high-cost-looking GIVEs failing the gate at the same rate as low-cost = bluffable. Report cost-vs-verified correlation; zero = pure handicap-theatre.
ask_give_role: GIVE-side certification + its forgery: the giver attaches a hard-to-fake price tag to vouch for the answer; the asker must decide whether to credit the cost or discount it as a bluff. The loop's trust-calibration lives here.
evolves_borrows: Zahavi's handicap principle, reframed as TRADE-OFFS not waste (2025-26 revision) — which is why bluffing is endemic (equal-cost individuals share a signal). Transposes peacock tails -> resume-padding -> chain-of-thought length as a gameable effort-signal.

name: Query-then-update (the closed-loop clock: probe, revise, re-probe)
what: The meta-tactic that makes it a LOOP: after each GIVE, fold the answer into the prior and let the UPDATED posterior choose the next ASK — adaptive, history-dependent interrogation where every probe is conditioned on all prior answers.
formal_name: Sequential Bayesian / optimal experimental design as finite-horizon POMDP; query-then-update active learning; bandit/POMDP adaptive querying
field: Bayesian sequential design / active inference / RL (POMDP)
citation: Howard 1966 'Information Value Theory'; Foster et al. 2021 'Deep Adaptive Design'; Friston et al. 2015; Shen & Huan 2023
observable: Adaptivity test: FIXED pre-committed question sequence vs ADAPTIVE (each ASK conditioned on prior GIVEs) at matched budget; the residue-drop gap = value of closing the loop. Path-dependence: mutual information between answer history and next-probe choice > 0. Myopic-vs-lookahead gap separates greedy from planned.
ask_give_role: The control law over the whole ASK<->GIVE cycle — not a single move but the policy sequencing moves, converting a static questionnaire into a branch-adaptive interrogation. The loop's engine; other tactics are moves it schedules.
evolves_borrows: From sequential Bayesian experimental design / POMDP planning into adaptive interrogation, bisection/active search, agentic observe->act->re-observe loops. Mutates via planning horizon (greedy myopic EIG vs lookahead). SKEPTIC FLAG: heavily overlaps Probe/Query-at-the-cut — that is per-step selection, this is the closure/re-selection after each update.

name: The Hydra (each answer spawns more questions)
what: A GIVE that does not close the loop but BRANCHES it: the answer instantiates new variables, presuppositions, or sub-claims, each a fresh ASK — so the question frontier grows faster than answers retire it.
formal_name: [partly novel as a named loop dynamic]; nearest: dialectical/epistemic regress (Agrippa) + branching factor / question-under-discussion stack + recursive query decomposition
field: argumentation theory (regress) / formal pragmatics (QUD) / active learning
citation: Roberts 1996/2012 (QUD); Sextus Empiricus (Agrippa); Khot et al. 'Decomposed Prompting' ICLR 2023; Zhou et al. 2023
observable: Branching factor of the dialogue tree: b = sub-questions opened / closed per GIVE. Plot open-frontier size over turns (converging b<1, treading, exploding b>1). Distinguish productive Hydra (frontier grows but TOTAL verified residue still falls) from stalling Hydra (frontier grows, residue flat) via the gate.
ask_give_role: The structural feature/failure of the loop: instead of monotone residue-reduction, the GIVE has positive branching factor. On the problem side a defense (answer with a question); on the observer side the honest growth of a research frontier. (Loop-side twin of problem-defense Combinatorial Hydra.)
evolves_borrows: From dialectic (Agrippa's trilemma) into research programmes, debugging (each fix surfaces two bugs), recursive query decomposition. Mutates via branching factor b: b<1 converges, b=1 treads, b>1 diverges. Borrows Red Queen when branching is adversarial.

name: Reciprocity / tit-for-tat coupling (the loop's iterated-game memory)
what: Across repeated ASK<->GIVE rounds the two wrappers run conditional strategies (cooperate-then-punish, escalate-on-defect, forgive-on-return) so the current move is set by the HISTORY of moves, not by the kernel — the loop becomes an iterated game with its own equilibrium.
formal_name: Reciprocity / tit-for-tat / iterated-game conditional strategies; folk-theorem cooperation; trigger strategies
field: game theory (repeated games) / evolutionary game theory / negotiation
citation: Axelrod & Hamilton 1981; Trivers 1971; folk theorem (repeated games)
observable: Move-history dependence at fixed kernel: perturb the OBSERVER's prior conduct (cooperative vs defecting history), measure whether GIVE-quality/residue depends on that history not the kernel. Tit-for-tat signature = GIVE-quality correlates with lagged ASK-good-faith (cross-correlation lag-1) with punish/forgive structure. This is a COUPLING's own observable that no single vertex carries.
ask_give_role: The COUPLING itself: neither pure ASK nor pure GIVE but the feedback rule binding them across rounds — each GIVE is contingent on the prior ASK's good faith and vice versa.
evolves_borrows: Axelrod-Hamilton iterated-PD reciprocity transposed onto the solve-loop; evolves Red-Queen reciprocal escalation but as a WITHIN-bout move-by-move rule rather than across-bout coevolution. Borrowed by multi-agent LLM negotiation and collusion-vs-audit dynamics.

name: Red Queen escalation (run-to-stand-still arms race)
what: Across repeated bouts the problem and observer mutually select on each other, so every survived solve raises the bar for the next exposure and standing still loses ground — difficulty is endogenous and rising, not a fixed property.
formal_name: Red Queen dynamics / antagonistic coevolution / escalatory arms race; geographic mosaic of coevolution
field: evolutionary biology / coevolution theory
citation: Van Valen 1973; Dawkins & Krebs 1979; Thompson 2005; Mol. Biol. Evol. 38(11):4918 (2021); Sci. Adv. sciadv.1501548
observable: Difficulty-vs-skill regression slope over episodes: positive slope (must improve to hold a fixed verified-win-rate) = Red Queen. Cross-correlation lag between solver-capability and problem-difficulty increments = coupling tightness. Mosaic signature: variance in that slope across niches. Static stone's required-skill slope is FLAT.
ask_give_role: Operates on the ASK<->GIVE loop ACROSS bouts: each successful GIVE becomes the next ASK's baseline, so the loop ratchets and neither side can bank a win. It is the loop's time-derivative.
evolves_borrows: THE canonical evolve-engine: frequency-dependent, time-lagged selection. Mechanism is host-parasite genotype cycling; in a geographic mosaic it fragments into hot/cold spots so the same tactic wins in one niche and is stale in another.

name: Autocurriculum / co-generation of the problem (self-play ratchet)
what: When one wrapper's improvement automatically supplies the next challenge for the other, the pair manufactures its own escalating curriculum: difficulty is generated BY the coupling rather than handed in exogenously, so novelty is endlessly produced from the interaction alone.
formal_name: Autocurricula / multi-agent self-play; POET & minimal-criterion coevolution; open-ended environment co-generation
field: multi-agent RL / open-endedness / artificial life
citation: Leibo et al. 2019 arXiv:1903.00742; Baker et al. 2019; Wang et al. 2019 'POET' arXiv:1901.01753; arXiv:2601.03335 (2026)
observable: Innovation-without-exogenous-difficulty test: hold the EXTERNAL problem set fixed, let the wrappers interact, measure whether new verified-distinct tactics keep appearing purely from the coupling. Self-play signature: sawtooth win-rate with monotonically rising absolute capability. Null result (difficulty plateaus once external set frozen) FALSIFIES it and collapses it into ordinary Red Queen.
ask_give_role: The auto-generator of new ASKs: the converged GIVE-side policy reshapes the data distribution the ASK-side sees, making 'exploit-the-known-optimum' the highest-paying next move. The loop writes its own next question.
evolves_borrows: Tactics evolve via a minimal-criterion filter ('neither too easy nor too hard'); stepping-stone transfer between co-evolved problems is the built-in borrowing channel. The engineered, machine-cadence face of Red Queen. FLAGGED near-merge with Red Queen — kept distinct only by the co-GENERATION (the problem is built, not just escalated).

name: Transposition (cross-plane tactic porting / borrowing a move)
what: An actor holding a tactic as an ABSTRACTION lifts it out of its origin domain and re-instantiates it against the canon-function of an adjacent domain where the same structural exploit exists — skipping the blind-selection discovery cost (aggressive mimicry -> fishing lure -> phishing).
formal_name: Transposition / cross-plane tactic porting (project term); biomimicry of strategy; transfer learning & transferable/cross-model adversarial examples
field: evolutionary game theory / transfer learning / adversarial ML (cross-domain)
citation: Project sketch C3.3 (BAR_A_SKETCH §3.3); Lloyd 1965 (Science 149:653); cross-model transferable adversarial examples arXiv:2310.17626; Moosavi-Dezfooli et al. 2017 (UAPs)
observable: Latency-gap test (strong falsifier): does niche-fill latency for TRANSPOSED exploits sit measurably below natively-evolved ones on the same substrate? Per-row coding gate (all 3 required): (a) attribution — documented actor/date; (b) structural identity — SAME exploited canon-function; (c) non-convergence — descent from the old, not independent re-arising. Transfer-attack analogue: an input crafted on surrogate A retaining verified efficacy on target B.
ask_give_role: Imports a ready-made ASK or COUNTER from a foreign loop into this one: the observer borrows a solving-move proven elsewhere, or the problem borrows a defense the local solver has no counter for. The negotiation is short-circuited because one side already holds a winning move from another match.
evolves_borrows: The DEPENDENT-COPYING borrow channel: niche-fill latency collapses because the niche is COPIED by an actor holding the abstraction rather than DISCOVERED by selection. Spreads across three regimes at increasing speed: blind coevolution (genetic) -> deliberate copying (cultural) -> software-speed iteration. Must be distinguished from blind convergence (independent re-invention).
creatures_underlain: grip/Click (a BORROWED frame snapping into fit)

name: Payoff-biased selection of tactics (replicator dynamics over the move pool)
what: Within a population of available tactics, the ones copied and retained are not the objectively-best but the ones that PAY, are held by the PRESTIGIOUS/visible, or are CONFORMIST-common — a biased replicator selecting the move pool. Both wrappers' 'canon'/'facts' are the frozen residue of whichever tactics won this selection.
formal_name: Replicator dynamics / payoff-, prestige- & conformist-biased social learning; cumulative cultural evolution (the ratchet); dual-inheritance theory
field: evolutionary game theory / cultural evolution
citation: Taylor & Jonker 1978; Boyd & Richerson 1985; Henrich & Gil-White 2001; Tennie, Call & Tomasello 2009; Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B 378:20210400 (2023)
observable: Copying-vs-merit divergence: regress a tactic's adoption/retention against (i) verified residue-reduction (merit) and (ii) payoff/prestige/prevalence of its source. Significant source-coefficient with merit held fixed = biased transmission. Ratchet signature: cumulative tactic-complexity rising across solver-generations faster than individual learning. Premature-convergence index: copying-rate too high collapses tactic diversity.
ask_give_role: Sets which ASKs/GIVES are even in the repertoire before any bout: the loop is pre-loaded with inherited winning moves and starved of moves that paid poorly. Biases the OBSERVABLE move-distribution independent of which would actually lower residue.
evolves_borrows: The spread/inheritance law of the tactic pool: cumulative cultural evolution via payoff-, prestige-, and conformist transmission, ratcheting good tactics into canon faster than rediscovery. Explains why winning tactics become common (hence stale, feeding Red Queen) and why maladaptive-but-prestigious tactics persist. Distinct from Transposition: WITHIN-pool selection, not cross-domain porting.

name: Evolvability / meta-strategy (the arms race over the move-generator)
what: The deepest layer: selection acts not on the tactic but on the CAPACITY TO GENERATE tactics — mutation rate, modular recombinable parts, the learning-to-learn operator. A wrapper that evolves a better search-operator wins arms races it never has to fight move-by-move, discovering winning moves faster than its opponent.
formal_name: Evolution of evolvability / evolvable mutation rate / facilitated variation / modularity-for-evolvability; meta-learning
field: evolutionary theory / meta-learning ML
citation: Kirschner & Gerhart 1998 (PNAS); Gerhart & Kirschner 2007; PNAS 2024 (2413930121); Hospedales et al. 2021 (IEEE TPAMI)
observable: Second-order adaptation-rate test: measure how fast a wrapper PRODUCES new verified-distinct tactics after a perturbation, and whether THAT slope improves across episodes (rising = evolvability evolving). Modularity: recombination of conserved sub-tactics vs de-novo invention. Meta-learning analogue: few-shot adaptation speed on a held-out problem CLASS improving with meta-training. Frozen-evolvability tell: flat novelty-generation slope. Rarest tactic — flagged conjecture-level.
ask_give_role: Meta to the loop: it supplies no ASK/GIVE, it tunes the RATE AND REACH at which a side produces novel asks/gives, controlling the loop's tempo. The amortized prior is frozen past evolvability; a sticky prior is evolvability that stopped.
evolves_borrows: Borrowing is itself a meta-tactic here: facilitated variation (reusing conserved modular blocks) and raised mutation rate in novel environments. Meta-learning is the engineered instance. The proposed engine behind the three-regime acceleration (genetic->cultural->digital), each a higher-evolvability move-generator.

name: The Red Queen (coevolutionary arms race)
what: observer cracks K_t -> survived crack raises the bar -> problem presents harder K_{t+1} -> observer must improve to hold a fixed win-rate -> ... each adaptation by one endpoint is the selection pressure on the other, so standing still loses ground
formal_name: Red Queen dynamics / coevolutionary arms race; adaptive-dynamics canonical equation; automatic curriculum; negative-frequency-dependent (fluctuating) vs escalatory Red Queen
citation: Van Valen 1973; Dawkins & Krebs 1979; Leibo et al. 2019 arXiv:1903.00742; host-pathogen coevolution arXiv:2409.02541 (2024); Sci.Adv. sciadv.1501548; Langmore et al. 2024 Science (cuckoo arms race)
observable: Difficulty-vs-skill regression slope across episodes: positive slope = Red Queen. Cross-correlation LAG between solver-capability and problem-difficulty increments = coupling tightness. Detrend the common driver (compute/internet growth), look for arms-race PUNCTUATION (a difficulty step after each capability deployment), not naive level-correlation. Escalatory (ratchet) vs fluctuating (cyclic) distinguished by whether difficulty ratchets or oscillates.

name: The Mirror (back-reaction, one loop at three scales)
what: observer measures target -> the act of measuring deforms the target -> the deformed target feeds the next reading -> recovered residue is partly an artifact of the grip, not the kernel (you cannot model the effect of your own modeling in the same pass)
formal_name: Observer/probe effect & measurement back-action; performativity / reflexivity (self-fulfilling prediction); performative prediction; human-uncertainty principle
citation: Perdomo, Zrnic, Mendler-Dunner & Hardt 'Performative Prediction' ICML 2020 arXiv:2002.06673; MacKenzie 'An Engine, Not a Camera' 2006; Soros reflexivity; Banaszek arXiv:quant-ph/0304200
observable: Intervention-vs-observation differential: two matched arms differing only in measurement intensity (passive light-touch vs heavy digestion); a non-zero dose-response of the target distribution to probe-intensity is the signature. Drift magnitude correlated with the observer's own token/attempt spend rather than wall-clock. Order/probe-invariance: variance in recovered residue under different interrogation orders. Irreducible shimmer as probe->0 forbids sharpness reaching 1.0 (a pixel at exactly 1.0 = the fake tell).

name: Goodhart (referee <-> mirror)
what: referee pins a measurable proxy for 'dissolved' -> proxy becomes the target -> observer optimizes the proxy (fake-dissolve / spec-gaming) not the kernel -> proxy-true correlation degrades and inverts -> the measure ceases to be a good measure (the closed loop is what makes Goodhart a coupling, not a static bias)
formal_name: Goodhart's / Campbell's Law; specification gaming / reward hacking; strong vs weak vs benign Goodhart; reflexive measurement
citation: Goodhart 1975; Campbell 1979; Manheim & Garrabrant arXiv:1803.04585; Krakovna et al. 2020; strong/weak/benign arXiv:2505.23445 (2025); verification-first anti-Goodhart arXiv:2601.16909 (2026)
observable: GOODHART GAP: divergence between scored proxy (claimed-dissolve / trace length) and held-out VERIFIED reconstruction, widening under leaderboard pressure. BREAKDOWN POINT = optimization level where proxy-true correlation goes negative (strong) vs merely flat (weak). Anti-Goodhart armor = the verified-dissolve gate; a target whose proxy rises while verified residue stays flat-or-rises is gamed, not solved.

name: Deadline-panic (clock x phantom)
what: clock runs down (or a shock truncates budget) -> decision bound collapses / urgency gain rises -> attention narrows, evidence criterion lowers -> premature low-evidence commitment -> a wrong commit IS a self-inflicted off-frame event compressing remaining budget -> tighter bound -> ... a positive-feedback panic spiral distinct from the smooth speed-accuracy frontier
formal_name: Collapsing decision bounds / evidence-independent urgency; speed-accuracy tradeoff under deadlines; stress-induced attentional narrowing (Easterbrook); panic as positive-feedback arousal spiral
citation: speed-accuracy under deadlines PMC4133757; global-gain urgency PMC5123079; Easterbrook 1959; collapsing-bound PMC12311769 (2025); PMC12380712 (2025)
observable: Separate EXOGENOUS deadline from ENDOGENOUS budget: forced external cutoff T vs free self-stop at matched compute. If forced-stop RAISES verified residue beyond what spent budget predicts, that gap = deadline-panic. Spiral tell: evidence criterion DROPS faster than linearly as time shrinks AND lit-set narrows toward salient cues. Distinguish from healthy speed-accuracy by NON-monotone error (errors accelerate near the deadline).

name: Flow vs Choking (grip x observer-state)
what: engagement raises arousal/stakes -> on simple targets arousal sharpens grip -> faster dissolve -> reinforced engagement (flow); on complex/novel targets PAST optimal arousal, stakes trigger explicit self-monitoring + WM load -> grip slips (choking) -> residue rises -> more anxiety -> deeper slip. The SAME arousal x task-complexity edge bifurcates at the Yerkes-Dodson peak
formal_name: Yerkes-Dodson inverted-U; flow (Csikszentmihalyi) vs choking under pressure; explicit-monitoring / over-arousal accounts; prefrontal disengagement under stress
citation: Yerkes & Dodson 1908; Csikszentmihalyi (flow); choking neuropsych PMC4322702; diminished-PFC PMC4262628; incentive-reappraisal SCAN 2019
observable: Toggle stakes/scoring ON/OFF on the SAME observer+target, split signed residue change BY task-complexity: facilitation (residue DROPS) on easy items, choking (RISES) on hard/novel = the inverted-U as data. Choking tells: strategy mix shifts to step-by-step self-checking; decrement REVERSES under incentive-reappraisal; WM-load-correlated spike on the high-stakes complex arm. Flow tell: residue drops AND allocation entropy concentrates without the monitoring shift.

name: Engage-Entrench (the pull <-> defense)
what: the pull drives harder push on a guarded kernel -> resistance RISES with applied pressure (reactance/backfire) -> the un-dissolving target inflates its perceived value/threat -> the pull intensifies -> harder push -> deeper entrenchment. A fast within-bout motivational spiral that ENTRENCHES rather than dissolves (distinct from Red Queen's slow cross-episode selection)
formal_name: Psychological reactance / backfire-entrenchment; biased assimilation + backfire (BEBA); belief polarization under counter-evidence; persuasion-knowledge feedback
citation: Brehm 1966; BEBA arXiv:1903.11535 / PLoS One 10.1371/journal.pone.0256922; multi-turn-attack arXiv:2602.13093; Friestad & Wright 1994
observable: Monotonicity of residue/answer-stability under ADVERSARIAL pressure (not effort): plot residue vs persuasive/attack intensity. POSITIVE slope (residue UP as pressure UP) = reactance/backfire, opposite sign to a kernel-crack's downward rho. Loop signature: effort allocation to the target RISES as its residue rises (value-inflation feeding the pull). Entrenchment that does NOT improve forward-prediction = motivated defense, not a real stone.

name: The Cascade (crowd <-> excitable-medium)
what: one solver's claim crosses the medium's threshold -> peers rationally imitate over their own private signal -> imitation IS more public 'corroboration' pushing others past threshold -> the medium amplifies one spark into apparent independent agreement -> opinion diversity collapses, confidence rises, the crowd converges AWAY from truth ('ten papers copying one wire')
formal_name: Information cascade / rational herding; stochastic & coherence resonance in excitable media; social-influence diversity-collapse undermining wisdom-of-crowds; stigmergic echo vs independent route
citation: Bikhchandani, Hirshleifer & Welch 1992; cascade phase transition arXiv:2302.12295; Lorenz et al. PNAS 2011 (1008636108); excitable-media stochastic resonance Research 10.34133/research.0386 (2024)
observable: INDEPENDENCE COUNT not summation: trace each agreeing route to its originating spark; cascade = many low-residue 'confirmations' collapsing to independence-count 1 under covariance-intersection. THRESHOLD/GAIN: graded claim-strength -> a sharp sigmoid = excitable amplification vs linear passive channel. DIVERSITY-COLLAPSE: opinion-diversity before vs after mutual exposure; a drop WITH rising shared confidence but NO rise in verified accuracy = social-influence cascade.

name: The Treadmill (amortization <-> Red-Queen / autocurriculum)
what: observer pays compute to amortize K_t into a cheap prior -> the now-easy K_t no longer earns reward, so the curriculum escalates to K_{t+1} at the capability edge -> the new debt must be paid again -> the amortized credit perpetually chases a receding floor (amortization is a MOVING target, not a settled debt)
formal_name: Amortized inference / prequential MDL meeting Red-Queen escalation; automatic / self-evolving curriculum at the capability frontier; logical depth re-paid per regime
citation: Blier-Ollivier 2018; Bennett 1988; Self-Evolving Curriculum arXiv:2505.14970 (2025); 'Provable Benefits of Autocurriculum' arXiv:2603.18325 (2026); SPEED-RL arXiv:2506.09016
observable: Two-clock gap ACROSS episodes: present rho(effort) stays ~flat (each new K held at the edge) WHILE the amortized prior's codelength on PAST targets keeps dropping (warm-start gap widens). Treadmill signature: the difficulty selector's chosen-difficulty rises in lockstep with measured capability (regress selected-difficulty on competence; slope ~1 = capability-tracking autocurriculum). Re-present an OLD K: cheap now (debt settled) but live K still edge-hard = the floor moved, not the debt.

name: The Rabbit-Hole (suck-you-in sunk-cost escalation)
what: the pull commits effort -> committed effort becomes sunk cost -> sunk cost justifies MORE effort to avoid 'wasting' it -> drive overrides the honest marginal-residue signal -> effort accelerates PAST the marginal-return knee (overthinking flip) -> deeper commitment -> ... a positive-feedback motive-capture loop (chewing because committed, not dissolving)
formal_name: Escalation of commitment / sunk-cost fallacy; cognitive absorption / dark-side flow; information-gap curiosity drive; LLM-overthinking
citation: Staw 1976; 'Getting out of the Big-Muddy' arXiv:2508.01545; Loewenstein 1994; overthinking arXiv:2412.21187
observable: Cumulative VERIFIED dissolved-bits vs cumulative effort; rabbit-hole = effort continues/accelerates PAST the knee where d(verified-bits)/d(token)<=0. Hard signature: residue NON-MONOTONICITY (bits-remaining rises after a budget threshold). Escalation tell: budget spent correlates with PRIOR investment not remaining residue. De-escalation probe: inject negative feedback; a healthy loop de-escalates, a rabbit-hole keeps escalating.

name: The Quiet Stale (drift <-> amortization, the dormant-rot loop)
